article_content: Barbara Palvin, a celebrated Victoria's Secret model, stars in River Island’s vibrant new campaign. In striking nighttime images shot by renowned photographer Angelo Pennetta in London’s Chinatown, Palvin showcases the brand's autumn/winter 2013 collection. Styled by fashion favorite Beth Fenton, Palvin appears in outfits like a sparkling black and silver mini-dress, a chunky cable knit jumper, and a patterned Chinoiserie skirt, exemplifying high street glamour beyond lingerie modeling. At 19, Palvin rose to fame with her debut at the Victoria’s Secret show in November. She briefly made headlines due to rumors of a connection to singer Justin Bieber, who performed at the event, though Palvin has publicly denied these reports. The new River Island collection, available online from September, highlights bold metallics, sequins, and monochrome styles. This campaign follows the reveal of Rihanna’s latest River Island collaboration, launched earlier in the month. Rihanna’s new capsule has already attracted celebrity fans, with model Cara Delevingne posting a photo on social media wearing a red quilted bomber jacket and black beanie hat from the collection. Praising her friend’s designs, Cara called the pieces “amazing” and expressed her admiration for Rihanna’s style. Delevingne also credits Rihanna and supermodel Kate Moss for giving her fashion and skincare advice during stressful fashion weeks, sharing that Moss once arranged a doctor's visit to help with a skin issue before a Louis Vuitton show.

PORT-AU-PRINCE, Haiti — Bullets shattered the hospital’s windows as women holding their children ran from room to room, searching for cover while a heavily armed gang approached. The gunfire intensified, and the women screamed until a hospital employee pleaded for silence and instructed them to lie on the floor. Mothers, hands trembling, attempted to quiet their babies, uncertain if they would survive the Wednesday attack on the Fontaine Hospital Center in the Cite Soleil district of Port-au-Prince.

After hours under siege, the gunfire persisted relentlessly. Suddenly, a staff member appeared, quietly directing everyone to move to the front yard, where police officers with armored vehicles awaited. “Get in quickly!” employees urged as women, children, and hospital staff climbed into buses and ambulances, which police escorted out of Cite Soleil. For the underfunded and outmatched police force, the evacuation was a rare success. Hospital staff joined evacuees, some carrying plastic containers with newborns on oxygen.

This violent assault was the latest in a string of gang attacks on vulnerable communities in the Haitian capital, highlighting the government's inability to control rampant gang violence. The Haitian government requested the deployment of an international security force over a year ago, but assistance has not yet arrived.

Hospital director and founder Jose Ulysse expressed frustration with the government’s absence in confronting gangs but thanked the police for saving lives. He hopes to reopen the hospital soon, though many remain unsettled. Speculation suggests gangs may be asserting dominance amid ongoing turf wars, signaling that no one is safe.

The attack, which forced the hospital’s evacuation and left dozens of homes burning, was reportedly carried out by the Brooklyn gang, led by Gabriel Jean-Pierre, also known as Ti Gabriel. The gang is part of G-Pep, one of two major alliances vying for control in Haiti. Past attacks in Cite Soleil and elsewhere have claimed hundreds of lives, with widespread reports of looting, rape, and killings.

Between July 1 and September 30, more than 1,230 killings and 701 kidnappings were recorded in Haiti—a figure more than double that from last year, according to the United Nations. Ulysse noted that clashes intensified after the recent death of Iskar Andrice, a former teacher turned feared gang leader. Rival gangs have used boats to launch surprise attacks in Cite Soleil. “When a gang leader dies, others quickly fight for control—it’s a matter of territory and money,” Ulysse explained.

Residents now fear increasing violence as gangs compete after Andrice’s death. Edline Pierre, a 26-year-old mother of three, was at the Fontaine Hospital with her two youngest for treatment. As bullets struck the hospital, she hid under a bed with her children. She recalled people in the yard crying out for help and gangs debating whether to burn the hospital. Police continued to confront gang members as evacuees were transported to safety. Pierre, now sheltering in a safer area, does not know the fate of her oldest child and mother, whose home was burned.

Marie-Marthe Pierre, mother of four, also lost contact with her family after sheltering in the hospital during the attack. “We were stuck and vulnerable. Without the police, I don’t know what would’ve happened,” she said.

The Haitian National Police did not respond to requests for comment. Those interviewed praised both the police and Ulysse, who appealed for help on social media during the crisis. Yolande Saint-Philippe, tending to her grandchild—a child born from a gang rape—called Ulysse “a good man,” crediting him with moving victims to a safe location where they could receive care despite their malnutrition: “Lucky for us, God sent us a savior.”

Tragically, all were safely evacuated except a baby born during the attack, who died after a difficult birth because doctors could not assist under fire.

Coto reported from San Juan, Puerto Rico.

PORT-AU-PRINCE, Haiti — Kulky rozbíjely okna nemocnice, když ženy s dětmi v náručí pobíhaly po místnostech a hledaly úkryt, zatímco se přibližoval těžce ozbrojený gang. Střelba sílila a ženy křičely, dokud je zaměstnanec nemocnice neupozornil na nutnost ticha a nevyzval je, aby si lehly na zem. Matky, se třesoucíma rukama, se snažily utišit svá miminka, nevěděly, zda útok na Fontaine Hospital Center ve čtvrti Cite Soleil v Port-au-Prince ve středu přežijí.

Po hodinách obléhání střelba neustávala. Najednou se objevil zaměstnanec, který tiše nasměroval všechny na dvůr, kde čekali policisté s obrněnými vozidly. „Nastupujte rychle!“ pobízeli zaměstnanci, když ženy, děti i personál nemocnice nasedali do autobusů a sanitek. Policie je vyprovázela z Cite Soleil. Pro podfinancovanou a slabou policii to byl vzácný úspěch. Zaměstnanci se přidali k evakuovaným, někteří nesli plastové krabice s novorozenci na kyslíku.

Tento útok byl posledním z řady násilných činů gangů proti zranitelným komunitám v haitském hlavním městě a ukazuje neschopnost vlády zvládnout narůstající násilí. Haitská vláda požádala o mezinárodní bezpečnostní síly už více než před rokem, ale žádná pomoc zatím nedorazila.

Ředitel a zakladatel nemocnice Jose Ulysse vyjádřil frustraci z absence vlády v boji s gangy, ale poděkoval policii za záchranu životů. Doufá v brzké znovuotevření nemocnice, ačkoliv mnozí zůstávají v nejistotě. Spekuluje se, že gangy chtěly útokem ukázat sílu během probíhající války o území a nikdo není v bezpečí.

Za útokem stála podle zpráv skupina Brooklyn vedená Gabrielem Jean-Pierrem alias Ti Gabriel. Gang je součástí aliance G-Pep, jedné ze dvou hlavních skupin soupeřících v Haiti o moc. Předchozí útoky v Cite Soleil a dalších oblastech vedly ke stovkám obětí, byly hlášeny i případy rabování, znásilnění a vražd.

Od 1. července do 30. září bylo v Haiti zaznamenáno více než 1 230 vražd a 701 únosů, což je více než dvojnásobek oproti loňsku, informuje OSN. Ulysse dodal, že střety se zintenzivnily po smrti Iskara Andrice, bývalého učitele, který se stal obávaným vůdcem gangu. Rivalové používají pro překvapivé útoky lodě. „Jakmile vůdce gangu zemře, ostatní bojují o území a peníze,“ vysvětlil Ulysse.

Obyvatelé se nyní bojí další eskalace násilí po Andriceho smrti. Edline Pierre, šestadvacetiletá matka tří dětí, byla v nemocnici se dvěma nejmladšími. Když na nemocnici dopadaly kulky, schovala se s dětmi pod postel. Vzpomíná na zoufalé volání lidí na dvoře a gangy, které debatovaly, zda nemocnici vypálit. Policie stále bojovala s gangy i při evakuaci. Pierre, nyní v bezpečí, nezná osud svého nejstaršího dítěte ani matky, jejich domov shořel.

Marie-Marthe Pierre, matka čtyř dětí, po útoku a ukrytu v nemocnici také ztratila kontakt s rodinou. „Byly jsme tam uvězněné a zranitelné. Kdyby nepřišla policie, nevím, co by se stalo,“ řekla.

Haitská národní policie se k situaci nevyjádřila. Ti, kteří přežili, chválili policii i Ulysseho, jenž v průběhu krize hledal pomoc na sociálních sítích. Yolande Saint-Philippe, která pečovala o vnuka narozeného po znásilnění gangem, nazvala Ulysseho „dobrým člověkem“ a poděkovala za převoz do bezpečí, kde byli i přes podvýživu v péči: „Naštěstí nám Bůh poslal zachránce."

Tragicky se všichni kromě dítěte narozeného během útoku z nemocnice dostali živí—novorozeně zemřelo kvůli nemožnosti lékařského zákroku při komplikovaném porodu.

O události informoval Coto ze San Juanu v Portoriku.

article_content: According to the 2011 census, White Britons no longer make up the majority of London’s population for the first time, highlighting the city’s growing cosmopolitan nature and its increasing divergence from the national economy. The data also revealed that the population of England and Wales is becoming better educated and less religious compared to a decade ago, and fewer people own their homes. England and Wales’ total population increased by 3.7 million to 56.1 million, a 7% rise since 2001. Migration accounted for 60% of this growth, amounting to 2.1 million people. Of the 13% of the population born outside the UK—7.5 million residents—just over half arrived in the past decade. In 2001, only 9% of the population was born abroad. London has experienced the most pronounced immigration surge: 37% of its residents were born outside the UK. Only 45% of London’s population identifies as White with English, Scottish, or Welsh heritage, down from nearly 60% in 2001, making London the first UK region where White ethnic Britons are a minority. India became the leading source of new migrants to England and Wales in the past decade, overtaking Ireland from the previous census period. Poland was the second-largest source, despite not being in the top ten in 2001. For the first time in 60 years of detailed records, home ownership rates have fallen over the past decade. The proportion of residents who either owned their home outright or with a mortgage dropped from 68% in 2001 to 64% in 2011, according to the Office for National Statistics. A larger proportion of people—31%—now own their homes outright compared to a decade ago, indicating a growing divide between established homeowners and those unable to enter the property market, often due to high prices and limited credit. Campbell Robb, chief executive of Shelter, a housing charity, stated: “These figures confirm that home ownership is slipping further and further out of reach, no matter how hard people work or save.” The share of people renting from private landlords rose from 9% to 15% over the past decade. Overall, educational attainment has improved: a higher proportion of the population now holds university degrees than have no qualifications, reversing the situation seen in 2001. In London, 44.7% of inner city residents have university-level education or better, compared to the national average of 27.2%. In five of 14 inner London boroughs, over half of the population holds university-level qualifications. Britain is also becoming less religious. The census question on religious affiliation was voluntary, but the proportion identifying as Christian fell from 72% in 2001 to 59% in 2011. The percentage of people reporting no religious affiliation increased from 15% to 25%. Christianity was the only major group to see a decrease in numbers despite overall population growth.
translated_content: Podle sčítání lidu z roku 2011 již poprvé v historii netvoří bílí Britové většinu obyvatel Londýna, což poukazuje na rostoucí kosmopolitní charakter města a jeho stále výraznější odlišnost od zbytku britské ekonomiky. Údaje také ukázaly, že obyvatelstvo Anglie a Walesu je vzdělanější a méně nábožensky založené než před deseti lety a méně lidí vlastní svůj domov. Celkový počet obyvatel Anglie a Walesu se zvýšil o 3,7 milionu na 56,1 milionu, což představuje nárůst o 7 % od roku 2001. Migrace se na tomto růstu podílela 60 %, což je 2,1 milionu lidí. Ze 13 % obyvatel narozených mimo Spojené království—7,5 milionu osob—více než polovina přišla v uplynulých deseti letech. V roce 2001 bylo v zahraničí narozeno pouze 9 % populace. Londýn zažil nejsilnější příliv přistěhovalců: 37 % obyvatel se narodilo mimo Spojené království. Pouze 45 % londýnské populace se hlásí k bílým s anglickými, skotskými nebo velšskými kořeny, což je pokles z téměř 60 % v roce 2001. Londýn se tak stal prvním regionem v Británii, kde jsou bílí Britové menšinou. Indie se v uplynulém desetiletí stala hlavním zdrojem nových přistěhovalců do Anglie a Walesu, čímž předstihla Irsko z předchozího sčítání. Polsko bylo druhým největším zdrojem přistěhovalců, přestože v roce 2001 nebylo ani v první desítce. Poprvé za 60 let podrobných statistik došlo v uplynulém desetiletí k poklesu míry vlastnictví domů. Podíl obyvatel, kteří vlastnili dům bez hypotéky nebo s hypotékou, klesl z 68 % v roce 2001 na 64 % v roce 2011, uvádí Úřad pro národní statistiku. Vyšší podíl lidí—31 %—nyní vlastní svůj domov bez hypotéky ve srovnání s před deseti lety, což ukazuje na rostoucí rozdíl mezi zavedenými vlastníky nemovitostí a těmi, kteří kvůli vysokým cenám a omezenému úvěru na trh s bydlením nedosáhnou. Campbell Robb, výkonný ředitel charitativní organizace Shelter, uvedl: „Tato čísla potvrzují, že vlastnictví domova je stále méně dosažitelné, ať už lidé pracují a šetří jakkoli tvrdě.“ Podíl lidí bydlících v soukromém pronájmu se za posledních deset let zvýšil z 9 % na 15 %.  Celkově se zvýšila úroveň vzdělání: vyšší podíl populace má nyní univerzitní titul než žádné vzdělání, což je opačný stav než v roce 2001. V Londýně má 44,7 % obyvatel vnitřního města vysokoškolské vzdělání nebo vyšší, ve srovnání s národním průměrem 27,2 %. V pěti ze čtrnácti centrálních londýnských čtvrtí má více než polovina populace vysokoškolské vzdělání. Británie je také méně náboženská. Otázka náboženského vyznání byla ve sčítání dobrovolná, ale podíl lidí hlásících se ke křesťanství klesl z 72 % v roce 2001 na 59 % v roce 2011. Podíl osob bez náboženské příslušnosti vzrostl z 15 % na 25 %. Křesťanství bylo jedinou hlavní skupinou, u níž čísla poklesla i přes celkový růst populace.

Rhys Webb, a qualified plumber and the Welsh national team scrum-half, is gearing up to face the New Zealand All Blacks this weekend. Webb aims to launch a strong offensive and reinforce the Welsh defence. Despite Wales’ last win over the All Blacks dating back to 1953, the 25-year-old remains optimistic, suggesting the world’s top-ranked team can be beaten.

Wales hopes to surprise the All Blacks in their final game of the season, drawing inspiration from England’s 2012 victory. Webb, who recently earned the starting scrum-half position from Mike Phillips, bases his optimism on New Zealand's close calls against Scotland and Australia, indicating the All Blacks’ vulnerability.

“They’re a world-class team at the top of the rankings,” said Webb. “But I believe they are there to be taken. Australia nearly beat them, and Scotland performed strongly against them. If we execute our game plan, play physically, and stay committed, we can put on a good show.”

Webb benefitted from guidance under 81-cap All Black Justin Marshall during his time at Ospreys, learning crucial aspects of game management and attacking play. On Saturday, he will face New Zealand’s Aaron Smith in Cardiff, hoping that Marshall’s mentoring will prove advantageous.

Webb is also part of Brynteg Comprehensive School's rugby legacy—following stars like JPR Williams, Gavin Henson, and Rob Howley, the latter now serving as assistant coach under Warren Gatland. Howley and Gatland regard the half-back pairing of Webb and fly-half Dan Biggar, forged at Ospreys in the Guinness PRO12, as crucial for Wales’ World Cup campaign.

The strong on-field understanding between Webb and Biggar is likened to other successful international duos. “We know each other inside out,” Webb explained. “As a nine, it’s vital to communicate with the ten, and Dan’s confidence and vocal leadership help direct the team.”

Webb experienced mixed fortunes in a recent loss to Australia: he scored a try but also conceded through an intercepted pass by Israel Folau. Webb states that consistency is essential to holding onto his starting jersey.

“One cannot take the starting spot for granted,” Webb said. “I’ve enjoyed my rugby this year, which has helped my selection chances. It means a lot to wear the Wales shirt and perform against one of the world’s best teams. Growing up watching Jonah Lomu, facing the All Blacks is truly a dream come true.”
translated_content:
Rhys Webb, vyučený instalatér a současný scrum-half velšské reprezentace, se připravuje na víkendový duel proti novozélandským All Blacks. Webb chce nejen vést útok, ale také vylepšit defenzivu Walesu. Přestože Wales naposledy porazil All Blacks v roce 1953, pětadvacetiletý hráč zůstává optimistický a věří, že je možné současné světové jedničky překonat.

Wales doufá, že All Blacks překvapí v posledním zápase sezony, inspirován vítězstvím Anglie v roce 2012. Webb, který nedávno nahradil Mikea Phillipse v roli hlavního scrum-halfa, svůj optimismus zakládá na těsných zápasech Nového Zélandu proti Skotsku a Austrálii, což ukazuje slabiny soupeře.

„Jsou to špičkový tým na vrcholu žebříčku,“ říká Webb. „Ale myslím, že jsou k poražení. Austrálie byla blízko a Skotsko jim také zatopilo. Pokud dodržíme herní plán, budeme hrát tvrdě a půjdeme do toho naplno, můžeme to zvládnout.“

Webb čerpal zkušenosti od 81násobného novozélandského reprezentanta Justina Marshalla během svého angažmá v Ospreys, kde se naučil klíčové prvky řízení i ofenzivní hry. V sobotu v Cardiffu nastoupí proti Aaronu Smithovi z Nového Zélandu a doufá, že Marshallovy rady mu pomohou.

Webb je také pokračovatelem tradice Brynteg Comprehensive School, stejně jako JPR Williams, Gavin Henson a Rob Howley, který nyní působí jako asistent trenéra pod vedením Warrena Gatlanda. Jak Howley, tak Gatland považují dvojici Webb–Biggar, která se sehrála v Ospreys v Guinness PRO12, za klíč pro šance Walesu na světovém šampionátu.

Silná souhra mezi Webbem a Danem Biggarem připomíná úspěšné mezinárodní dvojice. „Znám Dana dokonale,“ vysvětluje Webb. „Jako devítka musím přesně vědět, kde je desítka, a Danova hlasitost i sebevědomí opravdu pomáhají vést tým.“

Webb měl při nedávné prohře s Austrálií smíšený den: dal try, ale také umožnil soupeři skórovat po zachycené přihrávce Israelem Folauem. Uvědomuje si, že pokud chce udržet místo v sestavě, potřebuje trvale vysoké výkony.

article_content: In the World Economic Forum’s Global Risks Report 2023, climate change mitigation failure is identified as the most significant long-term global threat. Respondents warned that the inability to reduce greenhouse gas emissions poses severe risks over the coming decade. While COVID-19 lockdowns briefly reduced global emissions, upward trends quickly resumed. A June 2023 study in Earth System Science Data cautioned that the world is rapidly depleting its remaining ‘carbon budget’—the maximum carbon dioxide emissions allowed to keep global temperature rise within 1.5°C of pre-industrial levels. Supporting this concern, the UNEP Emissions Gap Report 2023 noted that by September 2023, global average temperatures reached 1.8°C above pre-industrial figures. The EU’s Copernicus Climate Change Service projects 2023 to be potentially the hottest year ever recorded. Since the 2015 Paris Agreement, efforts have slowed the projected 2030 rise in greenhouse gas emissions from 16% to 3%. Yet, meeting the agreement’s temperature targets requires a much faster, broad-based shift to low-carbon development, especially within the energy sector. The report further explains that fulfilling countries’ unconditional Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) could lead to a 2.9°C temperature increase, while implementing conditional NDCs would lower this to 2.5°C—both above safe levels considering worsening climate impacts. Countries heavily reliant on carbon-intensive industries risk reduced competitiveness from rising carbon costs, falling resilience, slower innovation, and weakened positions in trade agreements. However, moving away from such industries brings risks of economic disruption, unemployment, and greater social and geopolitical tensions. A transition that overlooks these challenges could widen global inequalities and fuel further conflict. Rapid decarbonization may cause significant short-term disruptions, while a slow transition may lead to intensified long-term problems. Sustainable and clear policy is crucial for long-term value creation. India faces a unique challenge in balancing ambitious economic growth targets with the urgent need to decarbonize. India’s robust post-pandemic growth, with a 7.2% year-on-year increase in 2023 and a projected 6.3% growth in 2024 (IMF estimate), marks it as one of the fastest-growing major economies. The nation aims to become a $5 trillion economy by 2025, focusing on innovation, technology, manufacturing, infrastructure, and digital transformation. Balancing rapid growth with decarbonization is critical. According to McKinsey (October 2022), industry, power, agriculture, and transport contribute around 89% of India’s emissions and are key to the economy. The adoption of technologies such as green hydrogen, carbon capture, and material circularity can help. However, industries will need government policy support to offset initial and operational costs of the transition. The first Global Stocktake’s Technical Dialogue in September 2023 stressed the need for comprehensive system transformations. Ambitious climate adaptation plans exist, but current efforts are scattered and uneven. Localized, context-aware adaptation boosts effectiveness and adequacy, potentially leading to major progress. To accelerate change, organizations should demonstrate leadership with bold climate commitments, investing in technology and R&D. Government policies can reinforce these efforts through clear, supportive frameworks, creating an ‘ambition loop’ where business and policy mutually drive progress. Realizing the full potential of climate action requires deep engagement and investment from all stakeholders. Sustainable, pragmatic action—rather than short-term, narrow approaches—is essential for lasting value. translated_content: Ve Zprávě o globálních rizicích 2023 Světového ekonomického fóra je selhání při zmírňování dopadů změny klimatu označeno za nejvýznamnější dlouhodobou hrozbu na světě. Respondenti varovali, že neschopnost snížit emise skleníkových plynů představuje vážné riziko v následujícím desetiletí. Ačkoli lockdowny během pandemie COVID-19 dočasně snížily celosvětové emise, trend nárůstu se rychle obnovil. Studie Earth System Science Data z června 2023 upozornila, že svět rychle vyčerpává svůj zbývající 'uhlíkový rozpočet'—maximální množství emisí oxidu uhličitého povolené k tomu, aby globální oteplování zůstalo do 1,5 °C nad úrovní před průmyslovou revolucí. Tuto obavu potvrzuje Zpráva o emisní propasti UNEP z roku 2023, která uvádí, že v září 2023 dosáhla globální průměrná teplota 1,8 °C nad předindustriální hodnoty. Evropská služba Copernicus pro změnu klimatu předpovídá, že rok 2023 by mohl být nejteplejším v historii měření. Od podpisu Pařížské dohody v roce 2015 došlo ke zpomalení předpokládaného růstu emisí skleníkových plynů do roku 2030 ze 16 % na 3 %. Pro dosažení cílů dohody je však nutný mnohem rychlejší a širší přechod na nízkouhlíkové hospodářství, zejména v energetickém sektoru. Zpráva dále uvádí, že naplnění bezpodmínečných národně stanovených příspěvků (NDC) může vést k nárůstu teploty o 2,9 °C, zatímco splnění podmíněných NDC by tento nárůst snížilo na 2,5 °C. Oba scénáře jsou však nad bezpečnou hranicí s ohledem na zhoršující se dopady klimatu. Země silně závislé na uhlíkově náročných průmyslech riskují ztrátu konkurenceschopnosti kvůli rostoucím nákladům na uhlík, snížené odolnosti, pomalejším inovacím a oslabení své pozice v obchodních dohodách. Přesto odklon od těchto odvětví přináší hospodářská a sociální rizika, vyšší nezaměstnanost a nárůst geopolitického napětí. Přechod, který tyto výzvy ignoruje, by mohl prohloubit globální nerovnosti a vyvolat další konflikty. Rychlá dekarbonizace může vést k výrazným krátkodobým otřesům, zatímco pomalý přechod by způsobil větší dlouhodobé problémy. K dlouhodobé hodnotě je klíčová udržitelná a jasná politika. Indie čelí jedinečné výzvě – sladit ambiciózní hospodářský růst s nutností rychle dekarbonizovat. Silný růst po pandemii (meziroční zvýšení o 7,2 % v roce 2023 a odhadované 6,3 % v roce 2024 podle MMF) řadí Indii mezi nejrychleji rostoucí hlavní ekonomiky. Země si klade za cíl stát se do roku 2025 ekonomikou o hodnotě 5 bilionů USD, s důrazem na inovace, technologie, výrobu, infrastrukturu a digitalizaci. Vyvážení rychlého růstu s dekarbonizací je zásadní. Podle McKinsey (říjen 2022) tvoří průmysl, energetika, zemědělství a doprava asi 89 % indických emisí a patří mezi klíčové sektory ekonomiky. Zavádění technologií jako je zelený vodík, zachycování uhlíku a materiálová cirkularita může pomoci, ale odvětví budou potřebovat vládní podporu na pokrytí počátečních i provozních nákladů přechodu. První technický dialog globální revize v září 2023 zdůraznil potřebu komplexních systémových změn. Ambiciózní adaptační plány existují, ale probíhající úsilí je roztříštěné a nerovnoměrné. Lokálně informovaná a kontextuální adaptace zvyšuje účinnost a může přinést zásadní pokrok. Pro urychlení změny by organizace měly jasně projevovat vůdčí roli, přijímat odvážné klimatické závazky a investovat do technologií a výzkumu. Vládní politiky mohou tyto snahy podpořit jasnými a stabilními regulacemi, díky nimž vzniká ‚smyčka ambicí‘, kde podnikání a politika navzájem posilují pokrok. Ke skutečnému využití potenciálu klimatických opatření je nutné aktivní zapojení a investice všech zainteresovaných stran. Udržitelná a pragmatická opatření – místo krátkodobých a úzkých přístupů – jsou klíčem k trvalé hodnotě. Ken Griffin, founder of the hedge fund Citadel, has expressed that Miami "represents the future of America" and suggested that it might one day overtake New York as the nation's leading financial hub. Citadel is currently constructing a new $1 billion headquarters in Miami's Brickell Bay district. In an interview with Bloomberg, Griffin commented that the city, referred to as "Wall Street South," could surpass its northern counterpart as more finance companies and tech leaders move to the area. He praised Florida's pro-business political environment for fostering growth, stating, "We'll see how big 'Wall Street South' becomes. We're on Brickell Bay, and maybe in 50 years we'll refer to New York as Brickell Bay North in finance."

Despite his optimism for Miami, Griffin shared positive remarks about New York as well, where Citadel plans a new 1,350-foot skyscraper. He described New York as the "epicenter of thoughtful people passionately engaged in their careers."

Last year, Citadel relocated its headquarters from Chicago, where the firm had been based since its inception, to Miami. Executives have cited Chicago's crime rate as a major factor influencing the move, with Griffin making a stark comparison by saying Chicago was "like Afghanistan on a good day."

Miami's financial district has earned the moniker "Wall Street South" after several major New York firms invested in the city's rapidly growing finance scene. Griffin is not alone in his praise of Miami; Amazon founder Jeff Bezos recently announced his own move to the city from Seattle, where he started the company. As CEO of Blue Origin, Bezos said his motivation was to be closer to his parents, though he will also benefit from significant tax savings, as Florida does not impose capital gains, estate, state income, or wealth taxes. Citadel did not immediately respond to a request for comment from Insider, which was made outside normal working hours.

Citadel v současnosti staví nové sídlo za 1 miliardu dolarů ve čtvrti Brickell Bay v Miami. V rozhovoru pro Bloomberg Griffin uvedl, že město, známé jako „Wall Street South“, by mohlo překonat svého severního rivala, protože se do této oblasti stěhuje čím dál více finančních firem a technologických lídrů. Vyzdvihl také floridské podnikatelské prostředí a podporu růstu: „Uvidíme, jak velký se ‘Wall Street South’ stane. Jsme na Brickell Bay a možná za 50 let budeme o New Yorku ve financích mluvit jako o Brickell Bay North.“

Citadel loni přesunul své sídlo z Chicaga, kde byl od svého vzniku, právě do Miami. Management firmy uvedl jako hlavní důvod stěhování kriminalitu v Chicagu; Griffin město přirovnal k „Afghánistánu v dobrý den“.

Finanční čtvrť v Miami si vysloužila přezdívku „Wall Street South“ poté, co do tamního rychle rostoucího finančního sektoru investovalo několik velkých newyorských firem. Griffinův optimismus sdílí i další významní byznysmeni – zakladatel Amazonu Jeff Bezos nedávno oznámil svůj přesun ze Seattlu (kde společnost založil) do tohoto města. Citadel na žádost Insideru o komentář, vznesenou mimo pracovní dobu, bezprostředně nereagoval.

At 2:20 p.m. Eastern Time this Wednesday, people all over the United States will receive a test alert on their cellphones, televisions, and radios. The Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) is conducting this nationwide test to ensure that emergency alert systems function correctly in urgent situations.

Messages will be sent through the Emergency Alert System (EAS) and Wireless Emergency Alerts (WEA), appearing on devices across the country. Phones using Spanish will display the alert in that language. The test is expected to last about 30 minutes.

FEMA has emphasized that the test is only meant to evaluate how well these alert systems work and will not collect any private data. FEMA is also addressing false information spreading on social media, explaining that people do not need to turn off their devices, that the alert isn’t harmful, and that it doesn’t cause devices to make noise for the full half-hour.

The test will activate on all phones, no matter the notification settings, but it will not require any action from users. If there is severe weather or a major event on test day, the exercise will be moved to October 11. Such drills are mandated by a 2015 law to make sure Americans can be quickly notified—within 10 minutes—in emergencies like natural disasters, terrorism, or other urgent public safety issues.

Ve středu ve 20:20 východního času obdrží lidé po celých Spojených státech testovací výstrahu na své mobilní telefony, televizory a rádia. Zprávy budou rozeslány prostřednictvím Systému nouzového varování (EAS) a Bezdrátových nouzových výstrah (WEA) a objeví se na zařízeních po celé republice. Telefony nastavené na španělštinu zobrazí výstrahu v tomto jazyce. Test potrvá asi 30 minut.

FEMA zdůrazňuje, že tento test slouží pouze k ověření, jak dobře systémy varování fungují a nebudou se při něm sbírat žádné soukromé údaje. Zároveň FEMA reaguje na nepravdivé informace na sociálních sítích a vysvětluje, že není nutné vypínat svá zařízení, výstraha není škodlivá a zařízení nebudou vydávat zvuk po celou dobu 30 minut.

Výstraha se aktivuje na všech telefonech bez ohledu na nastavení upozornění a nebude vyžadovat žádný zásah od uživatelů. Pokud by v den testu nastalo nepříznivé počasí nebo výjimečná událost, bude zkouška přesunuta na 11. října. Tyto zkoušky jsou povinné podle zákona z roku 2015, aby bylo zajištěno, že Američané obdrží výstrahu během nouzové situace – například při přírodní katastrofě, teroristickém útoku nebo jiné ohrožující události – do 10 minut.

With a swift signature, President Vladimir Putin has ushered Crimea into a new chapter, formally annexing the region back into Russian territory. This mirrors the transfer sixty years ago, when Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev just as rapidly handed Crimea over to Ukraine. However, addressing such a direct land acquisition is proving to be much more complex for the European Union’s 28 member states. Unlike Crimea’s hasty referendum, Europe’s response involves many voices and interests.

After initially imposing targeted visa restrictions and asset freezes on a handful of relatively unknown politicians and military officials, the EU now faces mounting pressure to expand its sanctions—this time aiming at Russia’s influential business elite. The rationale is that Russia’s leaders and wealth-holders are closely connected. Alexei Navalny, the prominent opposition figure currently under house arrest, has urged European leaders to broaden their restrictions, suggesting bans on figures ranging from Putin’s personal banker to Chelsea Football Club owner Roman Abramovich, preventing them from accessing their assets or families abroad.

Asset freezes and visa bans are especially attractive tools for the EU, as they can be applied selectively and without protracted legal delays. Russia, for its part, frequently cancels visas for those it finds objectionable—like Hermitage Capital founder Bill Browder, who lost entry rights and his Moscow-based assets in 2005. In retaliation for U.S. legislation targeting Russian corruption (named for Browder’s lawyer, Sergei Magnitsky, who died in a Moscow prison after alleged mistreatment), Russia also banned American adoptions of Russian orphans.

Yet, by leveraging financial sanctions, Europe must prepare for serious economic repercussions on both sides. Sanctions work both ways—imposing real costs on Russia while also affecting European interests. Targeting Russia’s globally mobile business class may weaken internal support for Putin and simultaneously give the EU an opportunity to address issues like money laundering and corruption, which have influenced high-value European assets, such as London real estate and art.

However, caution is advised concerning trade. Two decades of economic partnership and nearly $500 billion in commerce are at stake. Although Russia, dependent on EU markets for 15% of its GDP, might suffer more in a trade war, Europe’s own reliance on Russian gas poses significant risks to its industries and households. Maintaining open trade channels is vital not only for economic stability but also for ongoing dialogue as Europe’s economy recovers and Russia’s shows signs of weakness.

Prezident Vladimir Putin rychlým podpisem otevřel pro Krym novou kapitolu a formálně oblast připojil zpět k Rusku. Jde o paralelu s událostmi před šedesáti lety, kdy sovětský vůdce Nikita Chruščov stejně svižně předal Krym Ukrajině. Řešení takto přímé územní anexe je však pro členské státy Evropské unie mnohem složitější. Na rozdíl od uspěchaného krymského referenda je evropská reakce výsledkem mnoha hlasů a zájmů.

Poté, co EU nejprve zavedla cílená vízová omezení a zmrazení majetku několika méně známých politiků a armádních představitelů, sílí tlak na rozšíření sankcí–tentokrát na vlivné ruské podnikatele. Důvodem je těsné propojení ruských lídrů a majitelů významného majetku. Významný opozičník Alexej Navalnyj, který je nyní v domácím vězení, evropské lídry vyzval k rozšíření omezení, včetně zákazu přístupu k majetku a rodinám v zahraničí pro osobnosti od Putinova osobního bankéře až po majitele fotbalového klubu Chelsea Romana Abramoviče.

Zmrazení majetku a vízová omezení jsou pro EU atraktivními nástroji hlavně proto, že je lze uplatňovat selektivně a bez dlouhých právních průtahů. Rusko naopak často ruší víza těm, které nepovažuje za žádoucí–například zakladateli Hermitage Capital Billu Browderovi, který v roce 2005 přišel o právo vstupu i o majetek v Moskvě. V reakci na americkou legislativu, která cílí na ruskou korupci (pojmenovanou po Browderově právníkovi Sergeji Magnitském, jenž zemřel po údajném špatném zacházení ve vězení v Moskvě), Rusko také zakázalo adopce svých sirotků Američanům.

Při využívání finančních sankcí však Evropa musí počítat s vážnými ekonomickými dopady na obě strany. Sankce jsou oboustranné a přinášejí reálné náklady nejen Rusku, ale i evropským zájmům. Zaměření na globálně mobilní ruskou podnikatelskou třídu může oslabit vnitřní podporu Putina a zároveň poskytnout EU příležitost řešit problémy jako praní špinavých peněz a korupci, které ovlivnily hodnotné evropské majetky, například nemovitosti v Londýně či umělecká díla.

U obchodu je však na místě opatrnost. Dvě desetiletí hospodářského partnerství a téměř 500 miliard dolarů v obchodní výměně jsou v sázce. I když by Rusko, které je závislé na evropských trzích pro 15 % svého HDP, mohlo ve vzniklé obchodní válce utrpět více, závislost Evropy na ruském plynu představuje významné riziko pro její průmysl i domácnosti. Zachování otevřených obchodních kanálů je zásadní nejen pro ekonomickou stabilitu, ale i pro pokračování dialogu v době, kdy se evropská ekonomika zotavuje a ruská vykazuje známky slabosti.

article_content: Should Scotland become independent, patients currently waiting for vital organ transplants may have to wait longer or move to the back of the queue. Officials from the UK Department of Health have warned that the existing arrangements—where Scottish patients are eligible for organs from all over the UK—would be reevaluated following a 'Yes' vote, potentially leading to extended delays for more than 500 people in Scotland needing heart, lung, or liver transplants. Scottish patients now have access to over 40 specialized treatments in England, with organ transplant allocations managed on a UK-wide basis. These arrangements, including NHS Blood and Transplant’s systems, may not remain in place if Scotland becomes independent. Debate over the future of the NHS is at the forefront of the independence discussion. Labour leader Ed Miliband has warned that independence could jeopardize NHS funding, referencing claims that Scotland’s health budget could be cut by £1 billion annually, risking the equivalent loss of 36,000 nursing positions. These warnings align with concerns expressed by the Better Together campaign and include financial projections from the Bank of England. The SNP, meanwhile, describes such warnings as scaremongering and argues that staying in the UK brings its own risks for the Scottish NHS due to possible funding cuts.

article_content: With the Telangana assembly elections nearing, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi surprised locals by visiting a popular Hyderabad restaurant. Dressed simply, he mingled with both staff and customers, sharing lighthearted moments and conversations. Candid footage shows him engaged with people around a table, highlighting his approachable campaign style. Rahul Gandhi, along with Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, is leading his party’s push to regain ground in Telangana. The state, led by Chief Minister K Chandrasekhar Rao and his Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) party, will conduct elections on November 30, with results expected on December 3. The battle is primarily among the incumbent BRS, Congress, and the BJP. Earlier, Gandhi visited Ashok Nagar to meet local youth, many of whom voiced frustration over the limited job opportunities since Telangana became a state. In a social media post, Gandhi criticized the BRS government for its record on youth employment but commended the aspirations and determination of the young people he met. He promised that a Congress government would fill 200,000 government vacancies within its first year—an assurance he framed as a guarantee. These issues have gained more attention as the Telangana High Court recently annulled the Group-1 preliminary recruitment exams, citing procedural violations after complaints from students. This marks the exam’s second cancellation this year, further intensifying concerns among job seekers and drawing scrutiny towards the Telangana State Public Service Commission.

Before Caroline Ellison began dating Sam Bankman-Fried, she was intimidated by him. "I was kind of terrified of him," Ellison confided to author Michael Lewis. Lewis’ biography of Bankman-Fried, "Going Infinite: The Rise and Fall of a New Tycoon," was released this week.

Ellison, an effective altruist and former Jane Street employee, was persuaded by Bankman-Fried—a fellow alum from the firm—to leave her unsatisfying Wall Street job and join his cryptocurrency trading firm, Alameda Research. Just weeks into her new role, Ellison called her mother, expressing concerns that she had made a grave mistake, according to Lewis.

Lewis described Alameda Research as chaotic. Bankman-Fried expected employees to work up to 18 hours a day and to sacrifice any semblance of a normal life, according to cofounder Tara Mac Aulay. Mac Aulay said Bankman-Fried would skip meetings, neglect personal hygiene, let his workspace become messy with old food, and often fall asleep at his desk. He reportedly offered little management, preferring employees to approach him directly with questions, while sometimes playing video games during one-on-one meetings.

Ellison has described Alameda as a "super challenging environment" where she spent extensive hours at work. She became co-CEO of the firm in 2021.

Lewis’ book also sheds light on Ellison’s romantic relationship with the FTX cofounder. In one case, Bankman-Fried wrote Ellison a memo listing the pros and cons of a romantic relationship, in response to her own letter outlining their confusing dynamic. In the memo, Bankman-Fried reflected, "In a lot of ways I don't really have a soul. There's a pretty decent argument that my empathy is fake, my feelings are fake, my facial reactions are fake. I don't feel happiness. What's the point in dating someone who you physically can't make happy?"

Ellison told Lewis that Bankman-Fried often expressed conflicted feelings about their relationship, yet would continue the relationship before ignoring her for months at a time.

Ellison was thrust into public scrutiny when Alameda and FTX collapsed, ending Bankman-Fried’s trading empire. She later pleaded guilty to seven criminal charges in December 2022. Her sentencing is still pending.

Lewisova kniha také přibližuje Ellisonin romantický vztah se spoluzakladatelem FTX. V jednom případě Bankman-Fried napsal Ellisonové poznámku se seznamem pro a proti vztahu, jako reakci na její vlastní dopis popisující jejich složitou dynamiku. Ellison se dostala do centra pozornosti po pádu společností Alameda a FTX, kterým skončilo Bankman-Friedovo obchodní impérium. Později v prosinci 2022 přiznala vinu v sedmi trestních bodech. Na svůj rozsudek stále čeká.

A dramatic 300% rise in drug prices has swept Nigeria, leaving pharmacists and pediatricians deeply concerned about the growing scarcity and steep cost of children’s medicines. Many fear this trend will render vital treatments unreachable for families, increasing illness and childhood deaths.

According to the World Health Organization, Nigeria now ranks second globally for maternal, neonatal, and child mortality. Healthcare experts attribute much of the crisis to skyrocketing medicine costs brought on by a weakening naira, ongoing forex shortages, and GlaxoSmithKline’s exit from the nation. The Central Bank’s new flexible currency policy has further inflated the price of both local and imported drugs.

Rahman Bioku, who leads Bioraj Pharmaceuticals, notes that almost all pharmaceutical ingredients must be imported, and sourcing materials such as sugar—a key ingredient in pediatric formulas—has become very difficult. Sugar prices have nearly doubled, which has put many drug factories under strain, forcing some to close their doors and others to raise prices.

Bioku warns that oral rehydration solution (ORS)—crucial for children suffering from diarrhea, especially during the dry season—is vanishing from shelves, putting young lives at risk. He calls for prompt government action, including regulated drug pricing and investment in local production for pharmaceutical components, to prevent further public health emergencies.

Professor Aminu Mohammad of Bayero University points out that limited health budgets often neglect child healthcare across sub-Saharan Africa, deepening the crisis. Surging costs and reduced household incomes have left many children undernourished and immunocompromised, meaning simple ailments can quickly become life-threatening. With prescription drug prices out of reach, some parents are forced to request cheaper, less effective alternatives or go without treatment entirely.

Adewale Oladigbolu, president of the Association of Community Pharmacists of Nigeria, highlights that 99% of active pharmaceutical ingredients are sourced outside the country, and naira devaluation has made matters worse. While certain children’s medications receive government subsidies, Oladigbolu fears subsidy removal could drive prices even higher. He advocates broader health insurance coverage, saying it could ease family expenses, but many Nigerians remain without support. Together, health leaders warn that without decisive policy changes, Nigeria’s health system and reputation are at serious risk.

Odborníci varují, že bez rychlých změn v politice je ohroženo celé nigerijské zdravotnictví i jeho pověst.

article_content: Manchester United manager David Moyes attended Borussia Monchengladbach’s stadium on Friday night, accompanied by Toni Kroos’ agent after learning about a contract stand-off between the German midfielder and Bayern Munich. Initially, Moyes was believed to be interested in Bayern striker Mario Mandzukic and Monchengladbach midfielder Patrick Herrmann during the Bundesliga fixture, which Bayern won 2-0. Although both Mandzukic and Herrmann were of interest to Manchester United, Kroos has now emerged as a potential transfer target after Moyes, along with coaches Phil Neville and Steve Round, met his agent Sascha Breese from Sports Total at the match. At just 24, Toni Kroos already has 41 caps for Germany and joined Bayern from Hansa Rostock in 2006, establishing himself as a key midfielder. Kroos plays alongside stars like Bastian Schweinsteiger, Javi Martinez, Thiago, Thomas Muller, Mario Mandzukic, Arjen Robben, and Franck Ribery, and is known for his passing and vision. Manchester City fans may recall Kroos’s performance during Bayern’s 3-1 Champions League win at the Etihad earlier this season, where he played the full 90 minutes. Kroos was also influential in Bayern’s 3-1 victory over Arsenal at the Emirates last season, scoring the opening goal. With his current contract expiring at the end of next season and talks stalling, Kroos could fit in well at United in an area needing improvement. Bayern CEO Karl-Heinz Rummenigge acknowledged ongoing negotiations, stating: 'It is always about money in every agreement, and talks have so far failed to lead to a new contract for Toni. We are interested in prolonging his stay with us.' Bayern would likely seek at least £25 million for Kroos, and United have shown a willingness to spend with their recent £37 million signing of Juan Mata from Chelsea. Bayern are seeking to open talks with Mandzukic as well, but United could be encouraged by reported tensions between Mandzukic and coach Pep Guardiola. Mandzukic, contracted until 2016, was dropped from the squad for the match reportedly due to a lack of intensity in training. Club legend Franz Beckenbauer commented: ‘Mandzukic could pack his bags. I see Lewandowski in Bayern’s attack, as his playing style suits Guardiola’s approach more than Mandzukic’s. There are even more reasons why he could leave—Guardiola can still count on Thomas Muller and Mario Gotze in attack.’ During the match, Muller assisted a goal and scored a penalty, helping Bayern go 10 points clear at the top of the Bundesliga. Despite missing key players like Franck Ribery and Bastian Schweinsteiger, Bayern extended their unbeaten run to 42 league games. Gladbach had some close opportunities, with Max Kruse and Patrick Herrmann hitting the woodwork, but Bayern controlled the game with Philipp Lahm in midfield and Thiago orchestrating play. Gotze gave Bayern the lead early after Muller’s assist, and Muller converted a penalty in the second half. The loss was Gladbach’s first home defeat of the season. Other Bundesliga action includes Bayer Leverkusen, Borussia Dortmund, and Gladbach contending for the top positions. Max Kruse and Patrick Herrmann remain players of interest for Manchester United, with potential squad changes at Bayern as Robert Lewandowski’s arrival approaches.

article_content: Edward Bunyan, 16, and Indira Gainiyeva, 17, students at Stonyhurst College in Lancashire, have been located safe and well in the Dominican Republic after disappearing for a week. The teenagers, who left their £30,000-a-year boarding school and flew to the Caribbean, are now expected to return to the UK, Lancashire Police confirmed. Police have not revealed the exact hotel where Edward and Indira were staying, but stated that until recently, they had been at the five-star Occidental Hotel in Punta Cana. After being spotted, the two moved to another hotel, and Edward’s mother is now believed to be with them. Edward and Indira reportedly used their credit cards at the resort, according to local police. The pair, said to have been in a relationship for several months, left Stonyhurst College last Monday after telling friends they were tired of the rainy weather. The school has not commented on whether the students will face suspension or expulsion. Their disappearance generated significant media coverage, with classmates nicknaming them 'Bonnie and Clyde.' A Lancashire Police spokesperson said, 'The students have thankfully been located safe and well at a hotel in Punta Cana. Arrangements are underway for their safe return to the UK, where they will receive a welfare debrief from police. Our priority has been their safety and welfare; after this, police involvement will conclude.' Andrew Johnson, head of Stonyhurst College, expressed that he was 'absolutely delighted' the students were found. He thanked the school community for their support and indicated that discussions with the families would follow. He also said it is too early to discuss possible consequences. Edward, an experienced traveler who previously attended schools in Spain and Canada, is the son of a civil engineer from Cheltenham. Indira’s family is from Kazakhstan. The Occidental Hotel, used by tour operator Thomson, is a large beachfront resort with extensive facilities. Indira is believed to have been active online during their time in the Dominican Republic, while her parents made repeated appeals for her to make contact. Staff at Stonyhurst realized the students were missing when they failed to attend registration. Indira’s father, Ravil Gainiyev, explained that he was reluctant to cancel her credit cards out of concern for her welfare, while her mother expressed hope for her safe return.

article_content:
As it gradually became clear that quarterback Peyton Manning would not be healthy enough to play for the Indianapolis Colts this season, his teammates rallied around the idea that they were "not just a one-man team." Despite the team's culture of winning—including a Super Bowl title, another appearance, and consistent 12-win seasons—Manning's absence had a profound impact. Star players like Reggie Wayne, Dallas Clark, Dwight Freeney, Robert Mathis, and Jeff Saturday remained, but the team started the 2011 season with 13 straight losses and faced the possibility of becoming just the third team in modern NFL history to finish the year without a win or tie.

Previously viewed as the face of the franchise, Manning, a 35-year-old quarterback considered worthy of the Hall of Fame, demonstrated just how vital he was to the team's success—even without playing a single snap. Some have even argued that his impact made him deserving of Most Valuable Player consideration. The situation underscored how influential one player can be—not just in basketball, where stars like LeBron James can dramatically shift a team's fortunes, but also, unexpectedly, in football.

While the New England Patriots managed to go 11-5 without Tom Brady in 2008, the Colts struggled mightily without Manning. What was once a team debating the possibility of an undefeated season now questioned whether it could win a single game. Manning, once seen as the franchise’s symbol, revealed himself as its essential core.

The season’s difficulties were highlighted by a 62-7 loss to the Saints in New Orleans. Guard Ryan Diem admitted he was "shocked" by the team’s downturn. Initially, the Colts believed Manning—recovering from his second neck surgery—would return within the season’s first month. Ongoing pain and weakness, however, led to a third neck operation: a single-level anterior fusion. Kerry Collins, the quarterback brought in as Manning’s replacement, emphasized the complexity of taking over, noting that the offense was "built around a special guy" with exceptional football intelligence and skill.

With their foundation shaken, the Colts' top players—receivers like Pierre Garcon, Austin Collie, Reggie Wayne, and tight end Dallas Clark—struggled without Manning. Defensive stars, such as Freeney and Mathis, were less effective without the benefit of playing from a lead. Manning recently announced progress in his recovery, but it remained unlikely he would practice in the season’s final weeks.

Ironically, the Colts now found themselves well positioned to select Stanford quarterback Andrew Luck in the upcoming draft, widely considered the best quarterback prospect since John Elway. This potential transition prompted difficult questions: what to do with both Luck and Manning?

Archie Manning, Peyton's father, recently commented that Luck and Peyton could not play on the same team, as both would expect to start immediately—though he later softened this statement. The Colts faced a deadline over whether to pay Manning a $28 million bonus in March; releasing or trading him would have significant financial implications, including a $38 million salary cap hit.

Fans hoped for a transition that would allow Manning to play a few more seasons while grooming Luck, but this is complicated both financially and logistically. As Colts vice chairman Bill Polian noted, no decisions have yet been made.

For now, the most immediate concern is simple: the Colts just want to win one game.

Když se postupně ukázalo, že quarterback Peyton Manning nebude v této sezóně dost zdravý na hru za Indianapolis Colts, tým se semknul kolem tvrzení, že "nejsou jen jedním mužem". Přestože je zde tradice vítězství – titul v Super Bowlu, další účast ve finále a pravidelně 12 vítězství za sezónu – absence Manninga měla zásadní vliv. Hvězdní hráči jako Reggie Wayne, Dallas Clark, Dwight Freeney, Robert Mathis a Jeff Saturday zůstali, ale tým začal sezónu 2011 třinácti porážkami v řadě a hrozilo, že se stane teprve třetím týmem v moderní historii NFL, který zakončí rok bez vítězství nebo remízy.

Manning, dříve pouze tvář klubu, pětatřicetiletý quarterback se slibnou kariérou v Síni slávy, ukázal, jak klíčový je pro úspěch týmu – i bez jediného odehraného zápasu v sezóně. Někteří dokonce tvrdili, že díky tomu by si zasloužil cenu MVP. Celou situaci podtrhuje myšlenka, jak zásadní dopad může mít jeden hráč – nejen v basketbalu, kde hvězdy jako LeBron James mění tvář týmu, ale překvapivě i ve fotbale.

Zatímco New England Patriots dokázali bez Toma Bradyho v roce 2008 vyhrát 11 zápasů, Colts bez Manninga výrazně strádali. Z týmu, jenž uvažoval o možné neporazitelné sezóně, se najednou stal tým, který bojuje alespoň o jednu výhru. Manning, vnímaný jako symbol klubu, se tak ukázal jako jeho nepostradatelný základ.

Náročnost sezóny potvrdila i drtivá porážka 62:7 proti Saints v New Orleans. Guard Ryan Diem přiznal, že je "šokovaný". Původně Colts věřili, že se Manning po druhé operaci krku dokáže během prvních týdnů vrátit. Vytrvávající bolest a slabost však vedly k třetímu zákroku – přední fúzi jednoho obratle. Náhradní quarterback Kerry Collins zdůraznil, jak obtížné je tuto ofenzivu převzít, když byla "postavena na výjimečném hráči" s mimořádnou fotbalovou inteligencí a dovednostmi.

Po otřesení základů se elitní hráči Colts – receiveri Pierre Garcon, Austin Collie, Reggie Wayne a tight end Dallas Clark – potýkali bez Manninga s obtížemi. Obranné hvězdy jako Freeney a Mathis byly méně efektivní bez vedení v zápase. Manning oznámil pokrok v rehabilitaci, ale zůstávalo nepravděpodobné, že by v posledních týdnech sezóny s týmem trénoval.

Ironií je, že Colts jsou díky špatné sezoně v ideální pozici draftovat quarterbacka Stanfordu Andrewa Lucka, který je považován za nejlepšího talent tohoto postu od dob Johna Elwaye. Případný přechod vyvolává složité otázky: co s dvojicí Luck-Manning?

Manningův otec Archie nedávno řekl, že Luck a Peyton nemohou být ve stejném týmu, protože by oba chtěli nastupovat jako první – ačkoliv později svá slova zmírnil. Colts budou muset rozhodnout o zaplacení Manningova bonusu ve výši 28 milionů dolarů v březnu; případné propuštění nebo výměna by znamenaly i zásadní zásah do platového stropu (38 milionů dolarů).

Fanoušci by si přáli hladký přechod, kdyby Manning ještě pár let hrál a Luck se učil, ale to je složité jak finančně, tak prakticky. Jak uvedl viceprezident Colts Bill Polian, žádné rozhodnutí zatím nepadlo.

Nejbližší cíl je teď ovšem jasný: Colts prostě chtějí konečně vyhrát jediný zápas.

article_content: Florence Crittenton High School in Denver, Colorado, is dedicated to supporting female students aged 14 to 21 who are pregnant or already mothers. The school provides parenting assistance, on-site day care, career guidance, and training in marketable job skills. Florence Crittenton Services of Colorado reports that more than 1,000 teenagers become pregnant annually in Denver County. The American Pregnancy Association notes that approximately 469,000 babies are born to teenage mothers across the United States each year. The school is featured in a new six-part TLC reality series premiering August 12, which offers viewers an inside look at the daily lives of these students as they balance motherhood and education. Cameras follow students, such as tenth-grader Londisha, as they attend classes, use the school’s day care facilities, and take part in school activities. Florence Crittenton provides events like grandparent breakfasts, CPR training, dads’ clubs, and literacy exchange days. Enrollment allows students to attend from one semester and up to five years, though most typically remain for 18 to 24 months. The school supports about 170 students per semester and enrolls around 280 students yearly. Classes run Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 3:15 p.m., with activities sometimes extending beyond regular hours. Student stories featured in the series, like Londisha’s, highlight the challenges and opportunities at the school. She discusses how the environment helps her catch up academically and provides support through difficult times, describing the emotional experiences and unique social dynamics among students. This reality show follows in the footsteps of hits like '16 and Pregnant' and 'Teen Mom,' aiming to shed light on the support and challenges faced by young mothers pursuing their education at Florence Crittenton High School.

article_content: Ronny Deila’s hopes for a fast-paced, high-scoring Celtic side are far from being realized, especially following this disappointing goalless draw against Ross County at Celtic Park. With only a few days left in 2014, Celtic struggled to create clear chances, and Ross County’s organized defense earned them a deserved point. The January transfer window may provide Deila with an opportunity to add some much-needed creativity to his squad. During the match, Ross County defenders Scott Boyd and Paul Quinn led a resolute backline, while Celtic’s Leigh Griffiths and John Guidetti failed to convert rare opportunities. Both sides had multiple injuries and were forced into early substitutions. For Celtic, Anthony Stokes left the pitch after just nine minutes with a calf problem, replaced by Callum McGregor, who was himself later substituted for Kris Commons. Meanwhile, Ross County’s Michael Gardyne was substituted after 38 minutes. The match included a minute’s silence for victims of the George Square bin lorry accident. Deila started with three strikers, but injuries soon disrupted his plans, leaving Guidetti and Griffiths less effective. Guidetti, eager to end his goal drought, failed to score, with Celtic’s closest chance coming when McGregor’s shot hit the crossbar and Guidetti couldn't finish the rebound. Celtic fans’ frustration was compounded by the team’s lacklustre play, but St Johnstone’s victory elsewhere allowed Celtic to extend their Scottish Premiership lead to five points. Despite their resilient display, Ross County dropped to the bottom of the table, but the point gained could be valuable as the season progresses. The match became heated at times, with referee Crawford Allan needing to manage tempers. Celtic’s Emilio Izaguirre and several Ross County players received yellow cards. The most dangerous moment for Ross County came late in the game when Filip Kiss hit the post, but Craig Gordon managed to keep Celtic level. Ultimately, the stalemate was greeted by boos from disappointed home fans. Celtic have now failed to score in a league match at Celtic Park for the first time since October 2011, and questions continue about the team’s direction and attacking threat under Deila. article_content: Prime Minister David Cameron faced calls last night to drop the EU's green energy targets, following warnings that these measures could increase the average family's energy bills by £150 over the next five years. Cameron is set to travel to Brussels this afternoon to discuss new targets that would require Britain to reduce carbon emissions by 40 percent by 2030. However, a new report from the think tank Open Europe claims existing targets are already impacting Britain's economy and living standards, and recommends they be abandoned. Government ministers assert these targets will strengthen the UK's energy security and create thousands of green jobs in the long run. The study, drawing on official government figures, suggests EU green initiatives have added £59 to the average dual-fuel energy bill in the UK so far, potentially rising to £149 by 2020 as the government targets 15 percent of electricity from renewables. The report also warns the impact on businesses will be greater, with average medium-sized firms expected to see energy bills rise by 23 percent due to EU measures. It argues that economic benefits of meeting these targets have been overstated. Report author Raoul Ruparel said Cameron should push to abandon the targets, and that the UK should act unilaterally if needed. He stated, 'Despite admirable goals, EU green policies have imposed large costs with limited benefit and conflicting priorities. With concerns about the cost of living and energy security, a major rethink of EU energy policy is essential.' The Department for Energy and Climate Change disputed Open Europe's analysis, insisting that the push for green energy is actually reducing bills. An official said, 'We estimate that, in 2013, household energy bills were around five percent lower than they would have been without our energy and climate policies. In 2020, we expect our policies will continue to reduce bills. We need a diverse energy mix, including renewables such as wind and solar, to lower reliance on energy imports.' Current EU targets require the UK to increase renewables from about 4 percent in 2012 to 15 percent by 2020—the fastest rise in the EU. Achieving this would mean about 30 percent of electricity coming from alternative sources, mainly onshore wind, which receives significant public subsidies. The report claims potential savings of up to £21 billion could be realized by ignoring the targets, exceeding possible EU fines of £220 million per year for non-compliance, with the savings redirected towards home insulation and energy efficiency. The authors argue that projected benefits were based on flawed assumptions, and that the initiatives have not led to a global emissions deal. Instead, the anticipated UK benefit of £160 billion in 2009 has turned into a likely net cost of £17 billion. Additionally, the report states that the policy hasn't improved energy security and may have made the UK more vulnerable to energy shortages. Downing Street maintains support for cutting EU carbon emissions by 40 percent by 2030, emphasizing any deal must be 'cost-effective, fair, and flexible.'

Cameron má dnes odpoledne odjet do Bruselu, kde bude diskutovat o nových cílech, které by po Británii požadovaly snížení emisí uhlíku o 40 procent do roku 2030. Nová zpráva think-tanku Open Europe však tvrdí, že stávající cíle již mají dopad na britskou ekonomiku a životní úroveň, a doporučuje je zrušit. Vládní ministři tvrdí, že tyto cíle posílí energetickou bezpečnost Spojeného království a v dlouhodobém horizontu vytvoří tisíce zelených pracovních míst. Studie, která čerpá z oficiálních vládních údajů, naznačuje, že unijní zelená opatření již zvýšila průměrný účet za energie v Británii o 59 liber a do roku 2020 může tato částka stoupnout na 149 liber, protože vláda usiluje o dosažení 15 procent elektřiny z obnovitelných zdrojů. Zpráva také varuje, že dopad na podniky bude ještě větší – u průměrné středně velké firmy se očekává zvýšení účtů za energie o 23 procent kvůli opatřením EU. Vzhledem k obavám o životní náklady a energetickou bezpečnost je zásadní přepracování energetické politiky EU.' Ministerstvo pro energetiku a změnu klimatu odmítlo analýzu Open Europe a trvá na tom, že podpora zelené energie ve skutečnosti účty snižuje. Jeden zástupce uvedl: 'Odhadujeme, že v roce 2013 byly účty britských domácností průměrně o pět procent nižší, než by byly bez našich energetických a klimatických politik. V roce 2020 očekáváme, že naše politiky budou účty nadále snižovat. Potřebujeme rozmanitý energetický mix, včetně obnovitelných zdrojů, jako je vítr a slunce, abychom snížili závislost na dovozech energie.' Stávající cíle EU požadují zvýšit podíl obnovitelných zdrojů v Británii z přibližně 4 procent v roce 2012 na 15 procent do roku 2020 – což je nejrychlejší nárůst v EU. Splnění tohoto cíle by znamenalo asi 30 procent elektřiny z alternativních zdrojů, zejména z větrných elektráren na pevnině, které jsou silně dotovány z veřejných prostředků. Zpráva uvádí, že by zrušení těchto cílů mohlo přinést úspory až 21 miliard liber, což převyšuje možné pokuty EU ve výši 220 milionů liber ročně za neplnění, a úspory by mohly být použity na zateplení domů a zvyšování energetické účinnosti. Autoři tvrdí, že předpokládané výhody byly založeny na chybných předpokladech a že tato opatření nevedla k celosvětové dohodě o emisích. Namísto očekávaného přínosu pro Británii ve výši 160 miliard liber v roce 2009 je tak pravděpodobný čistý náklad 17 miliard liber. Zpráva dále uvádí, že politika nezlepšila energetickou bezpečnost a mohla Británii vystavit vyššímu riziku nedostatku energií. Downing Street stále podporuje snížení emisí uhlíku v EU o 40 procent do roku 2030, ovšem zdůrazňuje, že každá dohoda musí být 'nákladově efektivní, spravedlivá a flexibilní'.

While his shirt appeared snug around his midsection last September, yesterday in Sydney, he displayed a flatter stomach and a more streamlined appearance while filming a cooking special on the steps of the Sydney Opera House. This visit followed a stop in Perth, where Oliver visited the most successful branch of his international restaurant chain, Jamie’s Italian.

Oliver, 38, was accompanied by his long-time friend and collaborator, Tobie Puttock, who has been working alongside him for 15 years and features in the new show. Known for his campaigns promoting the use of fresh foods and sensible eating, Oliver has also criticized governments for their efforts in addressing obesity. During a previous visit to Australia, he reacted sharply to questions regarding his weight, emphasizing the challenges of maintaining a healthy lifestyle working in the food industry. Oliver, a father of four with an estimated worth of £150 million, shared that he strives to stay active and eat healthily, training twice a week and making ongoing efforts to improve.

This may prompt other players, including Gabriel Martinelli, to shift into new roles, particularly on the left wing, as part of the anticipated restructuring. CBF president Ednaldo Rodrigues discussed the transition at a recent press event, noting that interim coach Fernando Diniz has a similar tactical approach to the incoming Ancelotti. With the Copa America ahead, there is optimism within the squad about Ancelotti’s impact. While Neymar has praised Ancelotti’s track record and influence, his own participation is in doubt due to his ongoing recovery. The country is hopeful that these changes will help the team recapture the Copa America title they lost to Argentina in 2021. Position adjustments among the attacking players are expected as Ancelotti reviews his options for reconfiguring the starting eleven.

article_content: Manchester United are persisting in their efforts to sign Brazilian defender Marquinhos from Paris Saint-Germain (PSG), despite PSG's reluctance to let him go. Marquinhos, a 20-year-old centre-back, is regarded as one of the top young talents in world football. He has had two impressive seasons at PSG since joining in the summer of 2013 for a fee believed to be around £30 million, when he was 19. United have reportedly made enquiries during the January transfer window but PSG firmly rejected their approach. United are keen to strengthen their defence this summer, targeting Nathaniel Clyne for right-back as well as aiming to bring in two top-level centre-backs. Marquinhos is said to be closely monitored by manager Louis van Gaal. PSG consider Marquinhos a key part of their defensive plans and are unwilling to sell him, although they are aware of growing interest from Manchester United. Marquinhos also holds a European passport, so he does not occupy a non-EU spot in PSG's squad—an important factor, as Ligue 1 limits squads to four non-EU players, which increases his value to the club. Should United wish to tempt PSG, they would likely have to surpass the £30 million paid for Rio Ferdinand in 2002 and the reported £40 million Manchester City paid for Eliaquim Mangala last summer. However, even a record fee for a defender may not be enough to convince PSG to sell, as the club is steadfast in rejecting United's interest. Marquinhos' agent has indicated publicly that several top European clubs, including United, are interested in the player—a move that may encourage PSG to offer improved terms. Reports suggest contract talks between Marquinhos and PSG are ongoing. Sources indicate that Marquinhos is happy at PSG, where his skills, attitude, and dedication have been widely praised. He adapted quickly after his arrival, even conducting mixed zone interviews in French within months, and he recently described PSG coach Laurent Blanc as 'the best coach a young defender could wish for.' Marquinhos is often seen celebrating with teammates like Thiago Silva and Adrien Rabiot. This summer, PSG are looking to significantly strengthen their squad, and the requirements of Financial Fair Play may necessitate some sales. While names like Edinson Cavani and Ezequiel Lavezzi are mentioned as potential departures, a significant offer for Marquinhos might force PSG to reconsider. The large television rights deal for Premier League clubs, who will share a £5 billion windfall from 2016, stands in contrast to Ligue 1's much smaller deal, worth £538 million per season—far less than the £1.7 billion per season that Premier League clubs receive from Sky Sports and BT. This financial disparity benefits English clubs in the transfer market and puts pressure on French clubs like PSG, who also face higher taxes. There are concerns this could increase the competitive imbalance in European football. Marquinhos has played a key role in PSG's defence this season but has often been deployed at right-back rather than his preferred centre-back position. Many observers believe Marquinhos is already a more complete centre-back than David Luiz or Thiago Silva.

United údajně učinili dotazy během lednového přestupového okna, ale PSG jejich nabídku rozhodně odmítlo. Marquinhos sehrál v obraně PSG klíčovou roli, ale často nastupuje na pravém beku místo své preferované pozice středního obránce. article_content: The Nigerian Academy of Engineering (NAEng) has launched a new engineering innovation competition for all Nigerians, including those in the diaspora, aimed at promoting infrastructure and technological development in the country. According to the Academy, the initiative seeks to scale up innovations by promoting them to investors and helping to commercialize new products. Speaking to journalists in Lagos, NAEng President Prof. Peter Onwualu noted that many Nigerians in both the informal and formal sectors have promising concepts and ideas that, with support, could make significant contributions to the nation’s production economy. He explained that commercializing these ideas would help reduce Nigeria's dependence on foreign goods and foreign exchange, while boosting the country’s GDP. Prof. Onwualu said, 'Our leaders are currently discussing the need to shift Nigeria from a consumption-based economy to a production-oriented one so we can stand out globally. There is a lot of pressure on the Naira because our production levels are low. This competition is part of efforts to build a more productive economy.' He added that the competition is open to all Nigerian engineers, scientists, technologists, technicians, craftsmen, and other professionals involved in engineering innovation. Top entries will receive cash prizes, public recognition, investor promotion, certificates, and plaques. Dr. Chukukeluo Chukwuogo, Chairman of the competition, outlined its objective as identifying, encouraging, and rewarding innovative works in science, engineering, and technology that solve societal problems and support economic development. He said the competition welcomes entries from any engineering field, including ICT/telecommunications, agriculture and food processing, energy and energy transition, renewables, infrastructure, health management, waste management, environmental protection, transportation, mining, mineral processing, artificial intelligence, robotics, climate change, and manufacturing. Technical Secretary Bayo Adeola said NAEng plans to make the competition an annual event. Submissions will occur in two stages, starting with a concept note phase lasting six weeks, ending November 27. The concept note should include a brief description of the innovation, the problem addressed, societal and economic benefits, engineering processes involved, the prototype’s development status, and supporting visuals or documentation. Honorary Secretary Christiana Adelowo added that all submissions would be screened to assess the degree of innovation, engineering content, originality, and impact on national development.

Podle akademie iniciativa usiluje o rozvoj inovací tím, že je představí investorům a pomůže s jejich komercializací. Prezident NAEng, prof. Peter Onwualu, při setkání s novináři v Lagosu zdůraznil, že mnoho Nigerijců v neformálním i formálním sektoru má slibné nápady, které s podporou mohou významně přispět k produkční ekonomice. Zdůraznil, že jejich komercializace pomůže snížit závislost Nigérie na zahraničním zboží a devizách a zároveň zvýší HDP. Prof. Onwualu řekl: „Naši představitelé nyní diskutují o potřebě posunout Nigérii od spotřební k produkční ekonomice, abychom mohli obstát na světové scéně. Na Nairu je vyvíjen tlak, protože příliš nevyrábíme. Tato soutěž je jednou z iniciativ na cestě k produktivnější ekonomice.“ Dodal, že soutěž je otevřená všem nigerijským inženýrům, vědcům, technologům, technikům, řemeslníkům a dalším odborníkům v oblasti inženýrských inovací. Nejlepší účastníci získají finanční odměny, veřejné uznání, propagaci mezi investory, certifikáty a plakety. Předseda soutěže, Dr. Chukukeluo Chukwuogo, uvedl, že cílem je identifikovat, povzbudit a odměnit inovativní práce ve vědě, inženýrství a technologiích, které řeší společenské problémy a podporují hospodářský rozvoj. Soutěž přijímá příspěvky ze všech inženýrských oborů, například ICT/telekomunikace, zemědělství a zpracování potravin, energetiky, obnovitelných zdrojů, infrastruktury, zdravotnictví, odpadového hospodářství, ochrany životního prostředí, dopravy, těžby, umělé inteligence, robotiky, klimatických změn a výroby. Technický tajemník Bayo Adeola sdělil, že NAEng plánuje soutěž pořádat každý rok. Přihlášky proběhnou ve dvou kolech, přičemž první je fáze zaslání konceptu v průběhu šesti týdnů, s uzávěrkou 27. listopadu. Koncept by měl obsahovat stručný popis inovace, řešený problém, společenské a ekonomické přínosy, popis inženýrských procesů, stupeň rozvoje prototypu a podpůrné vizuály nebo dokumentaci. Čestná tajemnice Christiana Adelowo uvedla, že všechny přihlášky budou posuzovány podle úrovně inovace, inženýrského obsahu, originality a dopadu na národní rozvoj.

article_content: A new global transport survey has found that India and Malaysia offer the cheapest air travel in the world, while travelers in Denmark, Finland, and Switzerland face some of the highest prices. The study, conducted by the Berlin-based travel platform GoEuro, evaluated average ticket prices for flights, trains, and buses across 51 countries on five continents, measuring the cost to travel 100 kilometers. The results show that in India, competitive pricing among airlines has driven the average cost of a 100-kilometer domestic flight down to just $10.36—about a third of the UK's air travel cost and a tiny fraction of Finland's $138.90, the most expensive country for flying. Interestingly, flying within India is sometimes cheaper than taking the train, which costs $15.98 for the same distance, while a bus journey is the most affordable at $6.17. Malaysia follows closely behind India, with an average airfare of $12.27 per 100 kilometers, and South Africa and Australia round out the top four at $12.48 and $13.09 respectively. The rock-bottom prices in India are largely due to intense competition among airlines for the country’s expanding middle class, and experts predict India will see domestic air travel grow to 159 million passengers by 2021. At the other end of the spectrum, Denmark is the priciest place to travel overall, averaging $39.84 for 100 kilometers by any mode of transport, followed by Switzerland at $38.28. For comparison, South Africa’s average travel cost for that same distance is just $1.88, a mere fraction compared to costs in Denmark. Surprisingly, the UK ranks as the 22nd most affordable country for travel when combining air, train, and bus fares, outpacing the US and most Western European nations except Spain and India.
