article_content: A comprehensive new study led by the University of Colorado Boulder reveals Himalayan glaciers are melting much more gradually than was once thought. Older theories estimated that these glaciers were losing up to 50 billion tons of ice each year, but the latest research using NASA's GRACE satellites indicates the yearly loss is closer to 4 billion tons. Past predictions warned Himalayan glaciers could shrink to just 20% of their current size by 2035, bringing catastrophic droughts and rising sea levels. These alarming estimates mostly came from observations of lower, easier-to-access glaciers—figures which were then generalized for the less accessible high-altitude glaciers. Professor John Wahr, co-leader of the study, explains that many higher-elevation glaciers are still cold enough to resist noticeable melting, even as the atmosphere warms. This new investigation relies on satellite technology that measures Earth's gravity to track glacier mass far more accurately than ground surveys. The updated findings suggest that across the planet, glaciers and ice caps are losing about 150 billion tons of ice each year—actually about 30% less than earlier calculations indicated. Some previous warnings, including those publicized by environmental advocates and the UN Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, predicted devastating glacier retreats with dire consequences. The new GRACE satellite data undermines such dramatic claims. Globally, the contribution from melting glaciers and ice caps amounts to an annual increase in sea level of approximately 0.4 millimeters. Between 2003 and 2010, GRACE satellites measured a loss of about 148 billion tons of ice per year, not counting certain fringe areas around Greenland and Antarctica. Traditional ground-based measurements have only covered a fraction of Earth’s roughly 200,000 glaciers, leaving much room for uncertainty. By comparison, the GRACE satellites—circling Earth in close tandem—can detect subtle gravitational changes that reveal ice mass variations across vast regions. Researchers noted that the total melting from 2003 to 2010 could theoretically cover the United States in about 1.5 feet of water. In total, land-based ice (including Greenland and Antarctica) contributed about 1.5 millimeters per year to global sea level rise for that period. Although this data provides a more accurate snapshot, scientists like Professor Pfeffer remain cautious, saying it’s difficult to predict exactly how glacier melt rates and sea level rise will evolve in coming decades. Improved understanding of underlying physics and better modeling are still needed.

Dřívější předpovědi varovaly, že himálajské ledovce by mohly do roku 2035 zůstat jen na 20 % své současné velikosti, což by způsobilo katastrofální sucha a zvýšení mořské hladiny. Profesor John Wahr, spoluautor studie, vysvětluje, že mnoho ledovců ve vyšších nadmořských výškách je stále dostatečně chladných na to, aby odolalo znatelnému tání, i když se atmosféra otepluje. Nové šetření se opírá o satelitní technologii, která měří gravitaci Země a umožňuje přesněji sledovat změny v hmotnosti ledu než pozemní sondy. Aktuální zjištění naznačují, že celosvětově ledovce a ledové čepičky ztrácejí asi 150 miliard tun ledu ročně—tedy přibližně o 30 % méně, než se dříve uvádělo. Některá dřívější varování, včetně těch od ekologických aktivistů a Mezivládního panelu OSN pro změnu klimatu, předpovídala drastický ústup ledovců s vážnými důsledky. Nová data ze satelitů GRACE tyto dramatické tvrzení zpochybňují. Celosvětově přispívá tání ledovců a ledových čepiček k ročnímu zvýšení mořské hladiny asi o 0,4 milimetru. V období 2003 až 2010 naměřily satelity GRACE ztrátu asi 148 miliard tun ledu ročně, což nezahrnuje některé okrajové oblasti kolem Grónska a Antarktidy. Tradiční pozemní měření pokryla pouze zlomek zhruba 200 000 ledovců na Zemi, což ponechává značné množství nejistoty. Naopak satelity GRACE, které obíhají Zemi v těsné blízkosti, dokáží detekovat jemné gravitační změny, které odhalují změny v hmotě ledu na velkých územích. Vědci poznamenali, že celkové tání v letech 2003 až 2010 by teoreticky pokrylo území Spojených států asi 45 centimetry vody. Celkově od ledovců na pevnině (včetně Grónska a Antarktidy) činil příspěvek k nárůstu hladiny moře v tomto období zhruba 1,5 milimetru ročně. Přestože tato data poskytují přesnější pohled, vědci jako profesor Pfeffer jsou opatrní a tvrdí, že je stále obtížné přesně předvídat, jak se tempo tání ledovců a zvyšování hladiny moře v příštích desetiletích vyvine. Je potřeba lepší pochopení základní fyziky a sofistikovanější modelování.

General practitioners (GPs) in the UK are set to debate whether patients should be charged up to £25 for appointments—a potential first since the National Health Service (NHS) was established in 1948. This proposal, to be discussed at the British Medical Association (BMA) conference in York, aims to address the problem of missed appointments, which cost the NHS an estimated £160 million annually. Should the motion be approved, the BMA would then decide whether to urge the Department of Health to enact a national charging system.

If implemented, the charges could help alleviate GP funding shortfalls. However, the initiative has sparked significant concern among senior doctors and patient advocates. In a letter to The Telegraph, over 500 doctors and medical students—including Clare Gerada, former chair of the Royal College of General Practitioners, and Dr Clive Peedell, leader of the National Health Action Party—warned that such fees would disproportionately impact the poorest and most vulnerable, likely worsening the nation's health. They argue user fees discourage accessing healthcare, increasing strain on emergency services and leading to poorer management of chronic conditions.

Some GPs have highlighted the burden of missed appointments, with one reporting an entire morning lost to no-shows. Proponents of charging suggest it could encourage patients to attend their appointments and help maintain free GP services in the face of rising demand from an aging and increasingly unhealthy population. The plan suggests possible exemptions or reduced charges for groups such as the elderly, children, and pregnant women.

Under the proposal, money raised would be retained by GP practices to reinvest in patient care, similar to current charges for administrative services. Comparisons are drawn to the system in France, where patients pay a flat rate but are mostly reimbursed by insurers.

Despite these arguments, leading figures within the BMA, as well as many campaigners and patient advocates, oppose the introduction of fees. Dr Chaand Nagpaul, chair of the BMA's GP committee, maintains that NHS care should be free at the point of delivery, warning that costs could deter sick individuals from seeking help. Others, such as Dr Mike Smith of the Patients Association, fear charging would drive more patients to already overstretched emergency departments.

The motion prompting this debate was proposed by the Wessex Local Medical Committee. Dr Nigel Watson, its chief executive, emphasized the necessity of discussing new funding methods for general practice but personally supports retaining free access. GPs will also vote on whether to oppose government proposals for extended surgery opening hours.

Debatu otevřel návrh od Wessex Local Medical Committee. Její výkonný ředitel Dr. Nigel Watson považuje diskusi o nových formách financování primární péče za důležitou, osobně je však pro zachování bezplatného přístupu. article_content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated on Wednesday that, in his third term as Prime Minister, he aims to make India one of the world's top three economies. Speaking at a public meeting in Damoh, Madhya Pradesh, ahead of the state assembly elections on November 17, Modi reiterated his commitment to combating corruption. He criticized the Congress party governments in Chhattisgarh and Rajasthan, alleging that their chief ministers were involved in betting and generating black money. Modi highlighted that after 2014, India’s economy improved from the 10th to the 5th largest in the world, surpassing the United Kingdom, which had ruled India for over 200 years. He explained, 'In 2014, when we assumed office, the nation’s economy was ranked 10th. It gradually moved up to 9th, 8th, 7th, and 6th, but few noticed. When it reached 5th place, overtaking the UK, the world took notice and began to focus on India.' The Prime Minister restated his ambition to bring India’s economy into the global top three during his third term. With Lok Sabha elections approaching next year, Modi warned that if Congress returns to power, the so-called '85 per cent commission system' would continue in the states, referencing a remark by former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi about welfare funds. Gandhi had said that only 15 paise of every rupee sent by the Centre reached the intended beneficiaries. Modi also addressed Congress’s intention to complain to the Election Commission regarding his pledge to extend the free ration scheme for the poor by five years. He dismissed their objections, stating, 'Let them complain, I will continue to work for the people's welfare.' Modi concluded by reaffirming his fight against corruption and asked the public if he should continue, to which the crowd responded affirmatively.

article_content: Many British holidaymakers eager for guaranteed sunshine are most likely to travel abroad on Monday, August 12. Although temperatures reached 26°C this week, more than a quarter of people in the UK still believe the country has some of the worst weather in the world. Wet and windy conditions throughout May and June left millions dissatisfied, with two-thirds feeling unhappy, according to a report by Post Office Travel. Staycations appear to be less popular this year, as many Britons say that persistent bad weather has affected their mood. August 12 has become the top choice for booking trips abroad to seek better weather. Nearly a quarter of people even report experiencing symptoms associated with Seasonal Affective Disorder due to the gloomy climate. In the search for sunnier destinations, the average Briton spends over two hours a week online looking for the perfect getaway. Paul Havenhand, Head of Travel at the Post Office, stated: 'It’s no surprise people are frustrated with Britain’s unpredictable weather. The news that the sunshine may not last has understandably made many consider heading overseas for their holidays.' While summer has finally arrived in Britain, many holidaymakers are still cautious after a wet spring. For example, a couple were seen enjoying the sunshine this week on New Milton beach in the New Forest, as the heatwave is expected to continue. The study also found that people’s desire to go on holiday varied by city, with Southampton residents feeling the most discouraged by the earlier bad weather, followed by those in Manchester, Leicester, and Plymouth. While one in seven plan to book a last-minute trip, a third say they prefer to stay at home to avoid further disappointment from the weather.

article_content: Richard Husband, 26, is accused of causing a fatal crash that killed an ambulance driver and a patient. According to testimony at Bournemouth Crown Court, Husband was driving a Seat Alhambra, transporting teenage pupils to Coxlease School in Lyndhurst, when he attempted to overtake another vehicle on the A337 between Lyndhurst and Brockenhurst, Hampshire. It is alleged that Husband’s manoeuvre forced an ambulance off the road, causing it to strike a tree. Paramedic Gillian Randall, 42, who was driving the ambulance, and patient Francis Ironside, 88, both died at the scene. The ambulance was transporting Mr Ironside, who was seriously ill, to Southampton Hospital. Witnesses described Husband as extremely distressed after the crash, reportedly saying, 'Oh my God, look what I've done' and 'I didn't see it,' while holding his head in his hands. In a statement to police, Husband said that loud music, turned up by teenage passengers, may have distracted him at the time of the crash. He claimed he had told them to lower the volume, and did so himself before the incident. The ambulance was reported to be traveling with lights and sirens, with witnesses including Dr Melissa Judd indicating she had pulled over to make way for the emergency vehicle. Husband maintains he did not see the ambulance before beginning the overtaking manoeuvre. Two other people inside the ambulance, David Ironside (the patient's son) and paramedic Richard Riley, were also seriously injured. Richard Husband, from Brockenhurst, denies two counts of causing death by careless driving. The trial continues.

Podle obžaloby tímto manévrem vytlačil sanitku ze silnice, což vedlo k nárazu do stromu. Zdravotnická záchranářka Gillian Randallová (42), která sanitku řídila, a pacient Francis Ironside (88) na místě zemřeli. Sanitka převážela pana Ironsideho, který byl vážně nemocný, do nemocnice v Southamptonu. Svědci popsali Husbanda jako velmi rozrušeného po nehodě, údajně říkal: „Můj bože, podívejte, co jsem udělal,“ a „Nevšiml jsem si toho,“ přičemž si držel hlavu v dlaních. Ve své výpovědi policii Husband uvedl, že ho v době nehody mohla rozptýlit hlasitá hudba, kterou pustili jeho dospívající spolucestující. Tvrdil, že je několikrát žádal, aby hudbu ztlumili, a nakonec ji sám těsně před incidentem ztlumil. Podle svědků, včetně doktorky Melissy Juddové, sanitka jela se zapnutými majáky a sirénou. Juddová uvedla, že zajela ke kraji vozovky, aby sanitce umožnila projet. Husband tvrdí, že sanitku před zahájením předjíždění neviděl. article_content: Film director Spike Lee and his wife, actress Tonya Lewis Lee, are offering their historic Manhattan mansion, Hatch House, for sale at $32 million. The 8,292-square-foot Spanish Revival home, once a stable, includes an internal courtyard with a fountain and has seen several prominent owners, notably burlesque performer Gypsy Rose Lee. Gypsy Rose Lee, celebrated for her striptease artistry, owned the Upper East Side residence until her death in 1970 and was famous for hosting lavish parties. Interior details have not been made public by Sotheby’s International Realty, but the home's historic grandeur is well noted. Erected in 1916, this three-story house with stuccoed walls and a red tile roof was originally stables purchased as a wedding gift by the Vanderbilt family for their daughter Barbara Rutherford upon her marriage to Cyril Hatch. Architect Frederick J. Sterner later transformed the property with a distinctive Spanish style, as reported by the New York Post. Initially purchased for $85,000, the property was sold in 1921 to Broadway producer Charles B. Dillingham, who, with his second wife, hosted social gatherings there until their divorce in 1924. Subsequently, Hatch House was home to Charles Lanier Lawrance, an aeronautical engineer associated with the Wright Brothers and the developer of an engine used by Amelia Earhart. By the 1940s, Gypsy Rose Lee had acquired the house, adding her own touches, such as gold monograms on doors and frescoes on the walls, according to Daytonian in Manhattan. The 26-room house reportedly contained seven bedrooms and a marble-floored living room. After Lee’s passing from lung cancer at age 59 in 1970, Dr. Ferrucio di Cori carefully preserved the interior and was instrumental in securing the house's designation as a landmark in 1977. In the 1980s, the artist Jasper Johns, known for the ‘Flag’ painting on display at the Museum of Modern Art, made Hatch House his home. He later sold it to Spike Lee in 1998 for $16.6 million.

Gypsy Rose Lee, známá svými striptyzovými vystoupeními, vlastnila rezidenci na Upper East Side až do své smrti v roce 1970 a byla proslulá pořádáním velkolepých večírků. Sotheby’s International Realty zatím nezveřejnila podrobnosti o interiéru, ale historický půvab domu je dobře známý. Postavený v roce 1916, třípatrový dům se štukovými zdmi a červenou taškovou střechou byl původně stáj, kterou koupila rodina Vanderbiltů jako svatební dar pro svou dceru Barbaru Rutherfordovou při svatbě s Cyrilem Hatchem. article_content: A significant settlement involving Purdue Pharma, the producer of OxyContin, aims to resolve thousands of lawsuits stemming from the opioid epidemic. The deal would see the Sackler family surrender their ownership of Purdue Pharma and pay up to $6 billion toward addressing opioid-related harm. In return, the family would be protected from future civil lawsuits regarding their role in the crisis. This outcome has divided families and victims. Some view the agreement as a necessary step toward closure and a source of funding for treatment, while others are upset by the notion that the Sacklers could preserve large profits and evade direct accountability—potentially setting a concerning example for future cases. On December 4th, the Supreme Court will consider whether federal bankruptcy law permits parties like the Sacklers—who haven’t filed for bankruptcy personally—to be shielded from lawsuits via such settlements. Lower court opinions differ, leaving the legality of these shields in question and influencing future approaches to mass liability lawsuits. Personal stories illustrate the divide: Ellen Isaacs, whose son Ryan died from opioid addiction after being prescribed OxyContin, initially embraced the deal but now opposes it, believing it unfairly advantages the wealthy. In contrast, Lynn Wencus, who lost her son Jeff, supports the settlement in hopes of achieving closure. Purdue aggressively promoted OxyContin starting in 1996, minimizing warnings about addiction. In 2007, it pleaded guilty to misbranding and paid over $600 million in penalties. Opioid overdose fatalities continue to rise, exceeding 80,000 annually, fueled in part by fentanyl's emergence. A broader wave of opioid litigation has resulted in over $50 billion in industry settlements. Purdue's deal stands out as one of the few to include direct compensation for individuals, with a $750 million pool expected to pay victims between $3,500 and $48,000 each. Amid mounting criticism, the Sackler name has largely been removed from cultural and educational institutions. While the family hasn’t received Purdue payouts since bankruptcy, they collected more than $10 billion in the previous decade. Objections to the Sackler protections come from the U.S. Bankruptcy Trustee and Attorney General Merrick Garland, reflecting a change in the Justice Department’s stance since the Trump administration. The Supreme Court's decision may ripple across other high-profile bankruptcy settlements, since third-party releases have been used before with mixed support. Proponents argue that allowing such releases is a standard tool to enable large settlements, but critics say the practice raises serious concerns about fairness and accountability.

Na oplátku by rodina získala ochranu před budoucími občanskými žalobami týkajícími se své role v krizi. Tento výsledek rozděluje oběti a jejich rodiny. Nejvyšší soud USA se 4. prosince bude zabývat otázkou, zda insolvenční právo federálního státu umožňuje, aby strany jako Sacklerovi – kteří sami nevyhlásili bankrot – byly chráněny před žalobami tímto typem vyrovnání. Nižší soudy vydaly rozdílná stanoviska, což ponechává legalitu této ochrany v nejistotě a může ovlivnit budoucí řešení hromadných sporů. Příběhy obětí ukazují rozpor: Ellen Isaacs, jejíž syn Ryan zemřel na závislost na opioidech poté, co mu byl OxyContin předepsán, nejprve dohodu podpořila, ale nyní je proti, protože se domnívá, že nespravedlivě zvýhodňuje bohaté. Oproti tomu Lynn Wencus, která přišla o syna Jeffa, dohodu podporuje a doufá ve vnitřní klid. Společnost Purdue začala agresivně propagovat OxyContin v roce 1996, když zlehčovala rizika závislosti. Počet úmrtí na předávkování opioidy stále roste a překračuje 80 000 ročně, což je částečně způsobeno rozšířením fentanylu. Vlna žalob v souvislosti s opioidy vedla ke globálním vyrovnáním přesahujícím 50 miliard dolarů. Dohoda Purdue patří mezi málo těch, které přímo odškodňují jednotlivce – z fondu 750 milionů dolarů mají oběti dostat mezi 3 500 a 48 000 dolarů. Pod rostoucí kritikou bylo jméno Sackler odstraněno z mnoha kulturních a vzdělávacích institucí. Rodina nedostává platby od Purdue od bankrotu, ale během předchozího desetiletí získala přes 10 miliard dolarů. Proti ochraně Sacklerových se staví federální úřad pro insolvenci a ministr spravedlnosti Merrick Garland, což je změna oproti postoji ministerstva za vlády Donalda Trumpa. Rozhodnutí Nejvyššího soudu bude mít dopady i na další vysoce sledované vyrovnání v insolvencích, protože podobná ochrana třetích stran už byla použitá s rozdílnou odezvou. Zastánci tvrdí, že toto právní opatření je standardní nástroj pro uzavírání rozsáhlých vyrovnání. Kritici však upozorňují na vážné otázky spravedlnosti a odpovědnosti.

San Diego Mayor Bob Filner's former spokeswoman, Irene McCormack Jackson, filed a lawsuit against him for sexual harassment on Monday, calling him unfit to hold any public office. Jackson alleges she and other women were subjected to inappropriate comments and touching by Filner, creating a degrading work environment. She resigned as Filner's communications director in June, saying she realized the mayor would not change his behavior.

"I had to do my job in an atmosphere where women were seen as sexual objects or treated disrespectfully by Mayor Filner," Jackson said. She described repeated sexual advances, including requests for her to work without underwear. "He is not fit to be mayor of our great city. He is not fit for public office. A person lacking character undermines their own ideas," she added.

Although Filner has faced sexual harassment allegations for several weeks, Jackson is the first to file a lawsuit. Her attorney, Gloria Allred, urged Filner to resign, saying, "Apologies alone will not suffice to address this injustice."

In a statement Monday evening, Filner said the accusations saddened him, but he remained committed to serving San Diego. He called for due process, asking the public to withhold judgment until all facts are presented. Last week, he expressed hope for vindication after a full presentation of evidence. Filner also admitted that he "needs help," acknowledging he had not fully respected the women who worked for or with him, and at times intimidated them. He said recognizing and challenging such inappropriate behavior is progress.

Jackson's lawsuit names both Filner and the city as defendants. San Diego City Attorney Jan Goldsmith said his office will defend the city but not Filner personally, who has retained his own lawyer. Asked if he would call for Filner's resignation, Goldsmith declined, citing pressing legal responsibilities.

Filner, 70, was elected mayor in 2012 after five terms in Congress. Congresswoman Susan Davis joined other officials in calling for his resignation Monday, stating Filner had lost the confidence of the community. She described his conduct as reprehensible, regardless of its legality, and lamented that he squandered the public’s trust.

Other prominent Democrats, including former City Councilwoman Donna Frye, had previously made allegations against Filner. Jackson said her decision to resign was finalized after Filner's deputy chief of staff left in June, following a meeting where Filner dismissed warnings about his unacceptable behavior.

The San Diego Sheriff's Department has opened a hotline for accusers, who can remain anonymous. The department confirmed it had received calls since the hotline's announcement, but gave no additional details.

Jackson uvádí, že ona i další ženy byly vystaveny nevhodným poznámkám a dotykům ze strany Filnera, což vytvářelo ponižující pracovní prostředí. Další významní demokraté, jako bývalá radní Donna Frye, už dříve obvinili Filnera z nevhodného chování. Jackson dodala, že její rozhodnutí o rezignaci bylo definitivní poté, co v červnu odešla Filnerova zástupkyně vedoucí kanceláře po schůzce, kde Filner odmítl výtky ke svému přístupu.

article_content: Frank Armstrong, former Assistant Commissioner of City of London Police, has been arrested on suspicion of leaking confidential information to the press. At 52, Armstrong had only recently been awarded the Queen’s Police Medal and had managed both high-profile security and fraud investigations across a distinguished career. His arrest, at his home in southwest London, marks the first for a senior official under Scotland Yard’s Operation Elveden, which investigates alleged bribery of public officials. Investigators have stated that there is currently no evidence that Armstrong received any payment for alleged disclosures. His detention comes only months after he transitioned from his police role into corporate security. This incident follows the arrest of Met Chief Superintendent Andy Rowell for similar alleged conduct, though like Armstrong, Rowell is not accused of accepting payment. These cases emerge as the Home Office weighs new policies on police–media relations, following recommendations from the Leveson Report. Critics argue that targeting informal communication may disadvantage investigative journalism and impede public oversight of law enforcement. A decade ago, Armstrong became known for a critical report that revealed police failures at Prince William’s 21st birthday party at Windsor Castle, making 28 recommendations for improved royal security. He pointed out that the event, held in a post–9/11 climate, should have had far tighter protection. Beyond his official duties, Armstrong was widely liked for his spirited personality, charity efforts, and support of colleagues. He left the City of London Police last September after a long tenure in senior leadership. More than 100 people—mostly journalists—have now been arrested across three linked operations examining bribery, phone hacking, and computer hacking: Elveden, Weeting, and Tuleta. Free press advocates like Padraig Reidy of Index on Censorship have criticized the crackdown on informal police–media contact, stressing that such relationships are vital for holding power to account. The Independent Police Complaints Commission has confirmed Armstrong’s arrest relates to the suspected unauthorized release of information to journalists, adding there is no evidence of any financial transaction.
translated_content: Frank Armstrong, bývalý zástupce komisaře Městské policie v Londýně, byl zatčen kvůli podezření z úniku důvěrných informací do médií. Dvaapadesátiletý Armstrong, jenž nedávno získal Královninu policejní medaili a během své výrazné kariéry vedl vysoce profilová bezpečnostní i podvodní šetření, je prvním vysoce postaveným úředníkem zatčeným v rámci operace Elveden, kterou londýnská policie zahájila kvůli podezření z úplatků u veřejných činitelů. Vyšetřovatelé zdůraznili, že v tuto chvíli neexistují důkazy, že by Armstrong za údajné úniky dostal peníze. Jeho zadržení následovalo několik měsíců po jeho přechodu z policie do soukromého bezpečnostního sektoru. Tento případ navazuje na zatčení hlavního superintendenta Metropolitní policie Andyho Rowella za podobné údajné jednání, který však také není obviněn z přijetí peněz. Tyto události přicházejí zároveň s tím, jak ministerstvo vnitra zvažuje nové zásady vztahů mezi policií a médii na základě doporučení zprávy Leveson. Kritici upozorňují, že postihování neformální komunikace může poškodit investigativní novinařinu a ztížit veřejnou kontrolu nad prací policie. Armstrong se do povědomí veřejnosti dostal před deseti lety, když zpracoval kritickou zprávu o selhání policie při oslavě 21. narozenin prince Williama na hradě Windsor, v níž navrhl 28 doporučení pro lepší zabezpečení královské rodiny. Uvedl tehdy, že akci, konanou po útocích z 11. září, měla být věnována daleko větší bezpečnost. Kromě své profese byl Armstrong známý svým charismatem, charitativní aktivitou a vztahy s kolegy. Policii města Londýna opustil loni v září po dlouholeté práci na vedoucích pozicích. V rámci tří provázaných policejních operací – Elveden (úplatky), Weeting (odposlechy) a Tuleta (počítačové útoky) – už bylo zatčeno více než 100 osob, převážně novinářů. Obhájci svobody tisku, jako Padraig Reidy ze sdružení Index on Censorship, kritizují zpřísnění postihů neformálních kontaktů mezi policií a médii a zdůrazňují jejich důležitost pro kontrolu veřejné moci. Nezávislá komise pro stížnosti na policii potvrdila, že Armstrongovo zatčení souvisí s podezřením na neoprávněné poskytování informací novinářům a dosud nebyly nalezeny důkazy o finančním protiplnění.

The New Nigeria People’s Party (NNPP) has weighed in on the controversy following the Appeal Court ruling that sacked Governor Abba Yusuf, calling it a "scandalous judicial debacle." The Certified True Copy (CTC) of the judgment, released publicly on Tuesday, contradicts what was announced at the Court of Appeal last Friday.

On Arise TV’s The Morning Show on Wednesday, NNPP spokesperson Ladipo Johnson said the Supreme Court would ultimately resolve the matter. He highlighted differences between the judgment delivered on Friday and the official CTC.

“It is very unfortunate that we have reached such a low point in our judiciary. As a legal practitioner, this situation pains me deeply. With only a 14-day window to file a Supreme Court appeal, it makes no sense to deliver judgment on Friday, but only provide the CTC to counsel five days later," Johnson said.

The PUNCH reported that the verdict announced last Friday suggested that the Appeal Court upheld the tribunal’s decision to remove Governor Abba Yusuf. Confusion arose on Tuesday when the CTC surfaced, four days after the verdict, revealing potential inconsistencies.

Governor Abba Yusuf, removed by the state governorship election petition tribunal, is the appellant at the Court of Appeal. The All Progressives Congress is the first respondent, the Independent National Electoral Commission is the second respondent, and the NNPP is the third respondent.

The last five paragraphs of the CTC are contradictory, adding to the confusion. Ladipo Johnson questioned, "How can the CTC signed by judges contain such conflicting conclusions? Were two judgments prepared? Leave the facts and law to the Supreme Court; our concern is the negative optics and eroding public confidence in the judiciary."

He added, "With today’s computer-generated documents, was something changed, cancelled, or is it a clerical error? There's a slip rule for minor mistakes, but this is not minor. The Court of Appeal must explain what happened and why it took four days to release the CTC."

He further emphasized, "If an unbiased panel is set up, justice will be done for millions in Kano who may not understand these legal technicalities—they just feel they are being cheated."

The PUNCH previously reported that the tribunal found Yusuf was not on his party’s membership list, as the Electoral Act requires parties to keep both hard and soft copies of members’ names. Johnson questioned, "If someone is not a member, could he have a membership card? These are issues for the Supreme Court to settle."

Nová nigerijská lidová strana (NNPP) se vyjádřila k polemice po rozhodnutí odvolacího soudu, které vedlo k odvolání guvernéra Abba Yusufa, a označila ji za „skandální soudní debakl“. Ověřená kopie rozsudku (CTC), která byla zveřejněna v úterý, je v rozporu s tím, co bylo oznámeno minulý pátek u odvolacího soudu.

Ve středu v pořadu The Morning Show na Arise TV mluvčí NNPP Ladipo Johnson prohlásil, že konečné rozhodnutí v případu bude na Nejvyšším soudě. Poukázal na rozdíly mezi rozsudkem vyhlášeným v pátek a oficiální CTC.

„Je velmi nešťastné, že jsme se v našem soudnictví dostali na tak nízkou úroveň. Jako právník mě tato situace velmi zraňuje. Je na odvolání k Nejvyššímu soudu pouze 14 dnů, proto nedává smysl, když je rozsudek vyhlášen v pátek, ale CTC je advokátům doručeno až po pěti dnech,“ řekl Johnson.

Deník The PUNCH informoval, že rozsudek z minulého pátku naznačil, že odvolací soud potvrdil rozhodnutí tribunálu, který Abba Yusufa odvolal. Zmatek nastal v úterý, když se čtyři dny po rozsudku objevila CTC, která odhalila možné rozpory.

Guvernér Abba Yusuf, který byl odvolán státím volebním tribunálem, je odvolatelem u Odvolacího soudu. All Progressives Congress (APC) je první odpůrce, Nezávislá národní volební komise je druhý odpůrce a NNPP je třetí odpůrce.

Posledních pět odstavců CTC je rozporuplných, což zvyšuje zmatek. Ladipo Johnson se ptal: „Jak může být v CTC podepsané soudci tak rozporuplný závěr? Byly připraveny dva rozsudky? Fakta a právo má řešit Nejvyšší soud; naše starost je negativní dojem a ztráta důvěry veřejnosti v soudnictví.“

Dodal: „V dnešní době, kdy jsou soudní dokumenty generovány počítačem, byl nějaký obsah změněn, smazán, nebo jde o písařskou chybu? Pro drobné omyly existuje tzv. slip rule, ale toto drobnost není. Odvolací soud musí vysvětlit, co se stalo, a proč trvalo čtyři dny vydat CTC.“

Dále zdůraznil: „Pokud bude ustavena nestranná komise, bude spravedlnosti učiněno zadost pro miliony lidí v Kanu, kteří nechápou tyto právní technikálie – prostě se cítí podvedeni.“

Deník The PUNCH uvedl, že tribunál zjistil, že Yusuf není na členském seznamu své strany, přičemž volební zákon požaduje uchovávat seznam členů v tištěné i elektronické podobě. Johnson se ptal: „Pokud někdo není členem, může mít členskou kartu? To jsou otázky pro Nejvyšší soud."

Russia has relocated its navy-trained dolphins closer to active combat zones in the Ukraine war, according to Naval News. Satellite images reveal that militarized dolphin pens have been installed at the southern naval base in Novoozerne, located in western Crimea. Russia annexed Crimea from Ukraine in 2014, but its claim to the region is not internationally recognized.

The dolphin pens were previously observed near Sevastopol, a major Black Sea port. Novoozerne lies about 56 miles northwest of Sevastopol and is much closer to areas where Ukrainian special forces have recently carried out operations on the Crimean peninsula.

Moving the dolphins is likely an attempt to protect the Russian Black Sea fleet—which includes attack submarines and vessels with long-range strike capability—from ongoing Ukrainian assaults. The United States Naval Institute noted earlier this year that positioning dolphins at the mouth of the port could help prevent Ukrainian forces from infiltrating the harbour underwater.

Ukraine has become an increasingly significant player in the Black Sea, conducting multiple attacks using underwater sea drones and successfully seizing vital offshore gas platforms. Russia, which has a history of employing marine animals for military use, has increased the number of marine mammal pens around the Black Sea in recent months, according to a June intelligence update by the UK Ministry of Defence.

These dolphins are believed to be capable of detecting intruders, gathering intelligence, and potentially even delivering lethal attacks.

Ohrady pro delfíny byly dříve pozorovány u Sevastopolu, hlavního přístavu na Černém moři. Novoozerne leží asi 90 kilometrů severozápadně od Sevastopolu a je mnohem blíže oblastem, kde nedávno operovaly ukrajinské speciální jednotky na Krymském poloostrově.

Přesun delfínů je pravděpodobně pokusem chránit ruskou černomořskou flotilu – která zahrnuje útočné ponorky a lodě s dlouhým dosahem útoku – před neustálými ukrajinskými útoky. Podle United States Naval Institute by umístění delfínů u vjezdu do přístavu mohlo zabránit ukrajinským silám v proniknutí do přístavu pod vodou.

Ukrajina se stala stále výraznějším hráčem v oblasti Černého moře, když provedla několik útoků za použití podvodních námořních dronů a úspěšně obsadila důležité těžební plošiny v moři. Rusko, které má s vojenským využíváním mořských savců dlouhou zkušenost, v posledních měsících zvýšilo počet těchto ohrad v okolí Černého moře, uvádí červnová zpravodajská aktualizace britského ministerstva obrany.

article_content: The arraignment of former Central Bank of Nigeria Governor Godwin Emefiele at the Federal Capital Territory High Court was postponed due to a strike by the Trade Union Congress (TUC) and the Nigerian Labour Congress (NLC). The industrial action began following the alleged assault on NLC president Joe Ajaero in Imo State on November 1, 2023. Emefiele's court hearing, originally scheduled for Wednesday, could not take place due to the ongoing strike. During the court proceedings on November 9, Oyin Koleoso, counsel for the Attorney-General of the Federation, asked Justice Olukayode Adeniyi not to grant bail to Emefiele, citing the government's plan to arraign him on November 15. Koleoso argued that releasing Emefiele might hinder the prosecution's ability to secure his attendance at future hearings. Nevertheless, Justice Adeniyi granted Emefiele bail, ordering his release and directing that he be brought to court for arraignment on Wednesday. Court staff informed reporters that no proceedings were being held, as the Judiciary Staff Union of Nigeria had joined the strike. The courthouse was largely deserted, with lawyers and litigants absent at the time.

Justin Gatlin ran the fastest 100 metres in the world this year, clocking 9.77 seconds to claim a dominant victory at the Memorial Van Damme meeting in Brussels. The American sprinter, who has previously served two doping bans, extended his unbeaten run to 17 races at the final Diamond League event of the season. This time matches Gatlin's personal best, which he first set in 2006—then an equal world record—before it was annulled due to his doping suspension. The victory secured Gatlin the overall Diamond Race title, awarded to the season's top athlete across all 14 Diamond League competitions.

Gatlin finished ahead of a strong field, including American Mike Rodgers (second, 9.93 seconds) and Britain's James Dasaolu (fifth, season’s best 10.00 seconds). British hurdler Dai Greene, out with injury, commented on Twitter about the difficulties of seeing athletes with past doping bans win races.

Elsewhere, James Dasaolu said he was happy with his result, having placed ahead of accomplished competitors like Tyson Gay, Nesta Carter, Richard Thompson, and Kim Collins. In the women’s 400 metres hurdles, European champion Eilidh Child finished third with a time of 54.76 seconds.

Gatlin’s success continued in the men’s 200 metres, winning in 19.71 seconds just an hour after his 100m victory.

In the women's races, Allyson Felix of the USA won both the Diamond Race title and the year's top 200 metres time with a run of 22.02 seconds after returning from a nine-month injury layoff. France’s Myriam Soumare claimed second with a personal best of 22.11 seconds, while Britain's Jodie Williams, who finished eighth, admitted she was disappointed but acknowledged having had a strong season overall.

MotoGP will not hold a race in Argentina until 2014 after the cancellation of next year's event, following a dispute between Spanish oil company Repsol and the governments of Spain and Argentina. The race, initially scheduled as the second round of the season, became uncertain after the Spanish government issued a travel warning. The advisory, which discouraged Repsol-sponsored drivers or teams from traveling, was withdrawn on November 20, but the timing resulted in the event's cancellation.

Dorna Sports, the commercial rights holder of the MotoGP World Championship, stated: "The Gran Premio de la República Argentina, planned for the Termas de Rio Hondo circuit early next year, is not included in the 2013 calendar. On June 20, 2012, the Spanish government recommended that teams and riders sponsored by Repsol not travel to Argentina due to safety reasons. As a result, organizing the 2013 Argentine Grand Prix remained suspended until the recommendation was lifted. The deadline for Dorna Sports to formally propose the 2013 calendar to FIM was November 18. On November 20, the Spanish government informed Dorna of the withdrawal of their recommendation, but the calendar submission deadline had already passed, making it impossible to add a new event. Regardless, Dorna Sports commits to including the Argentine Grand Prix in the 2014 calendar, pending the track's homologation, which is expected in the first quarter of 2013. Dorna acknowledges the efforts of the local promoter regarding the completion of construction and preparations for the event."

Závod, jenž měl být původně druhým podnikem sezóny, byl zpochybněn po vydání cestovního varování španělskou vládou. Toto doporučení, odrazující jezdce a týmy sponzorované Repsolem od cesty, bylo sice 20. listopadu staženo, ale kvůli načasování byla akce zrušena.

Dorna Sports, držitel komerčních práv na Mistrovství světa MotoGP, uvedla: „Gran Premio de la República Argentina, plánované na okruhu Termas de Rio Hondo na začátku příštího roku, není zařazeno do kalendáře pro rok 2013. Dne 20. června 2012 doporučila španělská vláda týmům a jezdcům sponzorovaným Repsolem necestovat do Argentiny z bezpečnostních důvodů. Proto byla příprava Argentinské Velké ceny 2013 pozastavena, dokud by doporučení zůstalo v platnosti. Termín pro oficiální návrh kalendáře MotoGP ze strany společnosti Dorna pro FIM byl 18. listopadu. Dne 20. listopadu španělská vláda informovala Dornu o stažení doporučení, ale termín pro podání kalendáře již uplynul, takže nebylo možné přidat další podnik. I tak se společnost Dorna zavazuje zařadit Argentinskou Velkou cenu do kalendáře pro rok 2014, pokud bude dráha homologována, což se očekává v prvním čtvrtletí roku 2013. Dorna oceňuje úsilí místního promotéra při dokončení stavebních prací a přípravách na akci."

article_content: A BBC News investigation found that Hamas and five other Palestinian groups jointly prepared and trained for the large-scale attack on Israel that occurred on October 7, 2023. Their training—from 2020 onward—involved exercises closely matching the maneuvers carried out during the attack, including hostage-taking, storming compounds, and breaching the Israeli border. These drills took place at several sites in Gaza near Israel’s boundary and were openly posted on social media. According to evidence compiled by BBC Arabic and BBC Verify, Hamas aimed to unite different Gaza-based armed groups, refining their combined strategies for combat and enabling the surprise raid that led to significant violence and an ongoing conflict. The Strong Pillar drills, held multiple times since 2020, brought together Hamas and up to 10 other Palestinian groups under a joint command structure designed for coordinated action. The first Strong Pillar drill, staged in December 2020, saw Hamas leader Ismail Haniyeh call the exercises a strong sign of solidarity among Palestinian factions. The drills, repeated in subsequent years and widely documented in videos, included coordinated mock attacks, hostage scenarios, and simulated assaults on vehicles and buildings. After October 7, several groups publicized footage of their involvement. While Hamas led efforts to unify various armed groups in Gaza, investigations suggest only its senior leadership was aware of the full attack plan. Training footage showed masked commanders directing operations from underground bunkers, with actions such as mock rocket volleys and hostage-taking reflecting scenes later seen in the actual assault. Ayman Nofal, a senior commander in the Izzedine al-Qassam Brigades, stated that the drills were meant to reinforce unity and challenge Israeli border defenses. Exercises continued through 2022, with operatives filmed simulating the seizure of military bases and civilian buildings using tactics later deployed for real. Israeli intelligence agencies monitored these visible drills but often interpreted them as routine militant activities, missing their significance as rehearsals for a large-scale attack. The IDF sometimes launched airstrikes against training areas to disrupt operations. In the weeks before the October attack, Israeli soldiers reportedly spotted suspicious drone activity and simulated attacks near the border, but internal warnings were not addressed. Brigadier General Amir Avivi highlighted that, despite the public nature of the drills, Israeli forces failed to understand the groups’ true intentions. Hamas established training camps close to important sites—including near a UN aid distribution center and adjacent to major Israeli security installations—where they practiced realistic assault scenarios. BBC’s analysis identified 14 such sites across nine locations in Gaza. Fighters practiced infiltration tactics using pickup trucks, speedboats, and paragliders—several of which were seen during the October 7 operation. Video evidence shows these methods in training exercises both before and during the attack. Before this assault, estimates suggested Hamas had around 30,000 fighters in Gaza, with thousands more from allied groups. Yet the coordinated operation involved only a fraction of these combatants, believed by experts to reflect both tactical considerations and efforts to unify Gaza’s armed factions. Most allied groups were likely unaware of the entire plan until the day of the attack. Expert analysts note that the attack featured centralized planning led by Hamas, but relied on decentralized execution by various squads. Israeli intelligence now acknowledges it underestimated the risk, having viewed the joint drills as typical activities for groups in the region. Following the attack, Israeli forces have targeted Hamas leaders and training sites as part of countermeasures. The consequences for Israel’s military and security institutions remain significant and are expected to prompt ongoing investigation.

Jejich výcvik od roku 2020 zahrnoval cvičení, která těsně odpovídala manévrům během útoku, například braní rukojmích, obsazování objektů a prorážení izraelské hranice. Tyto drily probíhaly na několika místech v Gaze poblíž izraelské hranice a byly otevřeně zveřejňovány na sociálních sítích. Dle důkazů shromážděných BBC Arabic a BBC Verify se Hamás snažil sjednotit různé ozbrojené skupiny působící v Gaze, zdokonalovat jejich společné bojové strategie a umožnit překvapivý útok, který vedl k rozsáhlému násilí a pokračujícímu konfliktu. Cvičení Strong Pillar, které se od roku 2020 konalo opakovaně, spojovalo Hamás s až deseti dalšími palestinskými skupinami pod společným velením určeným k koordinované akci. První cvičení Strong Pillar se konalo v prosinci 2020 a lídr Hamásu Ismail Haníja tehdy označil manévry za silný projev solidarity mezi palestinskými frakcemi. Drily, opakovaně dokumentované na videích v následujících letech, zahrnovaly koordinované simulované útoky, scénáře s rukojmími a nácvik útoků na vozidla i stavby. Po 7. říjnu některé skupiny zveřejnily záběry své účasti. Ačkoliv Hamás vedl snahy o sjednocení ozbrojených skupin v Gaze, vyšetřování naznačuje, že pouze nejvyšší vedení Hamásu vědělo o plánu útoku v celém rozsahu. Výcvikové záběry ukazovaly maskované velitele řídící akce z podzemních bunkrů – včetně simulovaných raketových salv a braní rukojmích, které se později objevily v reálných událostech. Ayman Nofal, vysoce postavený velitel Brigád Izzedine al-Qassam, uvedl, že cvičení měla upevňovat jednotu a prověřit izraelské obranné linie. Cvičení probíhala až do roku 2022, kdy operativci před kamerami nacvičovali obsazování vojenských základen i civilních objektů podle taktiky, která byla později použita naostro. Izraelské zpravodajské služby tato veřejná cvičení monitorovaly, ale často je vykládaly jako rutinní aktivity militantů a nerozpoznaly je jako přípravu na velkou ofenzivu. Izraelská armáda občas podnikala letecké útoky na výcvikové areály, aby narušila provoz. V týdnech před říjnovým útokem izraelští vojáci údajně zaznamenali podezřelé aktivity dronů a simulované útoky u hranice, varování však nebyla řešena. Generál Amir Avivi upozornil, že přes veřejnou povahu cvičení izraelské síly skutečné záměry skupin neodhalily. Hamás zřizoval výcvikové tábory blízko klíčových míst – včetně rozdělovacího centra humanitární pomoci OSN a strategických izraelských instalací – kde nacvičovali realistické scénáře útoků. BBC evidovala celkem 14 těchto lokalit na devíti místech v Gaze. Bojovníci trénovali taktiky infiltrace pomocí pickupů, rychlých člunů i paraglidů – což se později skutečně objevilo během útoku 7. října. Videozáznamy ukazují, že tyto metody byly součástí výcviku i před samotným útokem. Před útokem se odhadovalo, že Hamás má v Gaze kolem 30 000 bojovníků a může počítat ještě s několika tisíci spojenců z jiných skupin. Koordinovaného útoku se ale účastnila jen malá část těchto sil, což experti připisují jak taktickým důvodům, tak snaze Hamásu sjednotit ozbrojené skupiny v Gaze. Většina spojeneckých frakcí prý o konkrétním plánu do poslední chvíle nevěděla. Odborníci upozorňují, že útok kombinoval centrální plánování pod vedením Hamásu s decentralizovaným provedením jednotlivými skupinami. Izraelská rozvědka dnes připouští, že riziko podcenila, protože společná cvičení vnímala spíše jako běžné aktivity těchto skupin. Po útoku začaly izraelské síly cílit na lídry Hamásu a výcviková centra v rámci protiopatření. Důsledky pro izraelskou armádu a bezpečnostní struktury jsou značné a očekává se jejich další vyšetřování.

article_content: Former referee and Sportsmail columnist Graham Poll has criticized the current standard of Premier League officiating, describing it as the worst he can recall. The organization that represents Premier League referees, Professional Game Match Officials Limited (PGMOL), responded to criticism from former referees' chief Keith Hackett. Hackett has called for his successor, Mike Riley, to be removed from his leadership of PGMOL, and claimed that the present group of officials is the worst seen to date, referencing over 20 major errors during the recent Christmas fixture period. Hackett, aged 70, suggested referees Mike Jones, Andre Marriner, Chris Foy, and Lee Mason should step down at the end of the season, while Lee Probert should leave his role if he fails a fitness test. PGMOL released statistics indicating that refereeing standards have improved since Hackett's departure. These figures include an increase in the accuracy of major decisions (from 94.1% to 95%), improvements in penalty box decisions (now at 98%), and offsides (99% compared to 92% five years ago). Hackett’s assertions were published on his website, which also provides refereeing equipment and training courses. Discussion about the quality of refereeing coincides with an upcoming debate about video replays, to be addressed at the International FA Board meeting in Belfast on February 28. However, video replay adoption could still be years away. PGMOL reports that referees' fitness, especially sprinting, has improved. Hackett pointed to several recent controversial decisions: Mike Jones awarding Liverpool two disputed penalties against Leicester City; Lee Mason failing to send off Stoke's Jon Walters for a last-man foul; Andre Marriner issuing only a yellow card to Eliaquim Mangala for a dangerous challenge; and Chris Foy giving Tottenham’s Kyle Naughton a red card for handball where evidence was unclear. Hackett called for comprehensive changes at PGMOL, including replacing the current General Manager and a thorough review of the organization’s structure and practices. Both Hackett and Graham Poll share the opinion that refereeing standards have declined, citing multiple significant errors and game-changing decisions this season. Hackett also referred to the controversial red card given to Swansea City's Wayne Routledge by Anthony Taylor—a decision overturned by the FA. He argued that PGMOL needs decisive leadership and a complete review to achieve its goal of delivering excellence in officiating. Though strongly critical, Hackett maintained that referees themselves are not inherently poor but require improved guidance and support to enhance their performance.

I přes tvrdou kritiku Hackett prohlásil, že samotní rozhodčí nejsou špatní, ale potřebují lepší vedení a podporu pro zlepšení výkonu.

article_content: A mother has praised the quick action by doctors who saved her daughter's life from an invasive Group A strep infection. Sofia Brooks, who was 17 months old at the time, was treated at Chelsea and Westminster Hospital in February. Her mother, Nikki Borkovic, said, "We know we are the lucky ones." Sofia has recovered and was able to walk down the aisle at her parents' wedding in the summer. Nikki added, "The symptoms can change and deteriorate very quickly." The UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) stated that invasive Group A strep (GAS) infections are rare and that current levels are in line with expectations for this season. Scarlet fever, caused by Group A streptococcal bacteria, mostly affects young children and is contagious. Sofia, from west London, contracted the illness in February. Initially, her parents thought she had a cold, but within a few days, she wasn't able to bear weight on her legs, her fever increased, her breathing became slightly raspy, and she grew more lethargic. Nikki felt something was wrong and took Sofia to A&E. Sofia was assessed and given IV antibiotics as her condition worsened. At one point, she was barely conscious, her body almost entirely swollen, and rashes spread over her body, a hospital spokesperson told BBC London. Sofia was treated for invasive strep A and spent seven weeks in hospital. She underwent four operations on an infected hip joint and received six general anaesthetics. Nikki said, "The decisive action by doctors in A&E to treat for invasive Group A Strep means our little girl was well enough to walk down the aisle at our wedding this summer, though she may need further surgery in the future." She advised other parents to "trust your instincts and seek help if something doesn't feel right." Dr Charles Stewart, a consultant in paediatric emergency medicine at Chelsea and Westminster Hospital, said most cases of Strep A present with mild, flu-like symptoms and can be treated with antibiotics. He added that if symptoms do not improve, parents should contact NHS 111 or their GP. In late 2022 and early 2023, there was an unusually high number of strep A cases. UKHSA reported 21 cases of invasive Group A strep in London between 11 September and 22 October, and 186 cases of scarlet fever during the same period. Dr Theresa Lamagni, senior epidemiologist at UKHSA, said current numbers are below the same time last year and much lower than the high levels seen last December. For more information on strep A, visit the NHS website.

Sofia Brooks, která měla v té době 17 měsíců, byla v únoru léčena v nemocnici Chelsea and Westminster. Její matka, Nikki Borkovic, řekla: "Víme, že máme štěstí." Sofia se uzdravila a mohla v létě dojít po uličce na svatbě svých rodičů. Nikki dodala: "Příznaky se mohou velmi rychle měnit a zhoršovat." Agentura pro zdravotní bezpečnost Spojeného království (UKHSA) uvedla, že invazivní infekce streptokokem skupiny A (GAS) jsou vzácné a současné úrovně odpovídají očekávání pro tuto sezónu. Spála, způsobená bakteriemi skupiny A streptokoků, nejčastěji postihuje malé děti a je nakažlivá. Sofia ze západního Londýna onemocněla v únoru. Zpočátku si její rodiče mysleli, že má jen nachlazení, ale během několika dnů už nechtěla stát na nohou, měla vyšší horečku, lehce sípavě dýchala a byla čím dál více unavená. Nikki cítila, že něco není v pořádku, a vzala Sofii na pohotovost. Sofia byla vyšetřena a dostala nitrožilní antibiotika, její stav se přitom dále zhoršoval. V jednu chvíli byla téměř v bezvědomí, celé její tělo bylo téměř oteklé a měla vyrážky po celém těle, řekl mluvčí nemocnice pro BBC London. Sofia byla léčena na invazivní streptokoka skupiny A a strávila sedm týdnů v nemocnici. Podstoupila čtyři operace infikovaného kyčelního kloubu a šest celkových anestézií. Nikki řekla: "Rozhodný postup lékařů na pohotovosti, když Sofii léčili na invazivní streptokoka skupiny A, znamenal, že naše holčička byla na svatbu dostatečně zdravá na to, aby mohla jít uličkou, i když je možné, že v budoucnu bude potřebovat další operaci." Ostatním rodičům poradila: "Důvěřujte své intuici a vyhledejte pomoc, pokud máte pocit, že něco není v pořádku." Doktor Charles Stewart, konzultant dětské urgentní medicíny v nemocnici Chelsea and Westminster, řekl, že většina případů streptokoka skupiny A má mírné příznaky podobné chřipce a lze je léčit antibiotiky. Dodal, že pokud příznaky neustupují, rodiče by měli kontaktovat NHS 111 nebo svého praktického lékaře. Koncem roku 2022 a začátkem roku 2023 byl zaznamenán nezvykle vysoký počet případů streptokoka skupiny A. Podle zprávy UKHSA bylo mezi 11. zářím a 22. říjnem v Londýně nahlášeno 21 případů invazivního streptokoka skupiny A a ve stejném období 186 případů spály. Doktorka Theresa Lamagni, hlavní epidemioložka UKHSA, uvedla, že současné počty jsou nižší než ve stejném období loni a výrazně nižší než vysoké hodnoty z loňského prosince. article_content: Mario Balotelli gave manager Brendan Rodgers a reminder of his abilities during an indoor Liverpool training session, accurately hitting a bottle with a football. However, this achievement came off the pitch rather than during a match. The 24-year-old striker has struggled to make an impact for the Reds since his £16 million move from AC Milan last summer, scoring just two goals in all competitions and still seeking his first Premier League goal. Due to his lack of form and limited playing time, Balotelli was linked with a transfer away from Anfield during the recent window, but a return to Italy did not happen. During Tuesday's training, Balotelli controlled the ball, struck it cleanly, and knocked over a bottle—demonstrating his technical skill. Despite recent challenges, there is still hope that Balotelli can revive his Liverpool career. He posted a video on Instagram showcasing his ball skills, accompanied by the message 'lol crazy easy,' as he knocked over a plastic bottle from distance with his right foot. Balotelli will aim to form a partnership with the now-fit Daniel Sturridge, who returned from a five-month absence to score in Liverpool's win over West Ham last Saturday. Balotelli celebrated after hitting the bottle target in training, but he has yet to score a Premier League goal for Liverpool since joining from AC Milan. His agent recently admitted that Balotelli has been 'very disappointed' with his time at Liverpool.

Balotelli se bude snažit vytvořit útočnou dvojici s uzdraveným Danielem Sturridgem, který po pěti měsících naskočil zpět do hry a vstřelil gól při vítězství Liverpoolu nad West Hamem minulou sobotu. article_content: Take a look inside one of Australia’s most distinguished residential properties—a mansion in Toorak, south-east Melbourne. Originally listed with an asking price of $25 million, it eventually sold at a sizeable discount. International mining speculator Socrates Vasiliades spent six years building this impressive three-level mansion at 3 Towers Road, set on 2,100 square metres. It features 22 rooms, a lift, home theatre, gym, swimming pool, and basement parking. When the property went on the market in 2011, it was hoped to fetch a record $30 million, as reported by Property Observer. Craftsmen from around the world were brought in during its lengthy construction. Vasiliades, born in Melbourne, moved in for just six days before relocating his family to Europe. The mansion was then listed for three years, starting from April 2011. The estate offers six bedrooms, two studies, Roman columns, and a range of living and dining zones off a striking entrance hall and corridor. The north-facing backyard includes a dramatic swimming pool set within manicured, park-like gardens in one of Melbourne's most prestigious neighborhoods. With impressive amenities, the estate represents a rare opportunity to acquire a significant generational asset. The mansion was initially offered at $30 million in May 2011, with a $25 million offer declined that year. Property Observer reports that the mansion was ultimately sold to Sarah Lew for an undisclosed sum, though Domain’s sources estimate the price may have been as low as $18.7 million. The modern kitchen boasts stone benchtops and opens directly to outdoor spaces with garden views. The home’s basement offers spacious garage parking, with additional room for entertaining guests in the indoor and outdoor dining areas. This exceptional property stands as one of Toorak’s most notable residential offerings, combining architectural grandeur with luxurious amenities.

article_content: Richard Almaraoui, 33, was sentenced to five years in prison after breaking into a flat while wearing an electronic tracking tag. Almaraoui, a repeat burglar from Dereham, Norfolk, was caught after the tag recorded his movements, linking him to the crime. During the burglary, he stole a student's laptop, which police later recovered from his home. At Norwich Crown Court, Almaraoui admitted the burglary and asked for five similar offences to be considered. He also breached a suspended jail sentence. Judge Stephen Holt, who presided over the case, warned Almaraoui that any further offences would lead to even longer sentences. He acknowledged Almaraoui’s difficult background and struggles with drug addiction, but stressed that only Almaraoui could stop himself from taking drugs. Defence lawyer Michael Clare stated that Almaraoui had stopped taking drugs while on remand and wanted to make a fresh start. Electronic monitoring of offenders in the UK, including ankle tags and satellite tracking, is managed by companies such as G4S and Serco. G4S monitors approximately 14,000 offenders, using GPS and mobile technology to track locations. Offenders wear an ankle tag connected to a tracking device, and a Home Extension Unit is often installed at their residence. This setup allows authorities to monitor their movements both inside and outside their homes. Electronic tags enable police to match offenders’ movements with reported crimes or to check if an individual was present at the scene when responding to emergency calls.

Almaraoui, opakovaně trestaný zloděj z Derehamu v Norfolku, byl dopaden díky tomu, že náramek zaznamenal jeho pohyb a spojil ho s trestným činem. Při vloupání ukradl studentský notebook, který policie později našla u něj doma. U soudu v Norwichi se Almaraoui ke vloupání přiznal a požádal, aby bylo zohledněno dalších pět podobných případů. Také porušil podmíněný trest. Soudce Stephen Holt, který předsedal případu, varoval Almaraouiho, že další trestné činy povedou k ještě delším trestům. Uznal jeho složité zázemí a boj se závislostí na drogách, ale zdůraznil, že jedině Almaraoui sám může přestat drogy užívat. Obhájce Michael Clare uvedl, že Almaraoui během vazby užívání drog ukončil a chce začít znovu. Elektronický dohled nad pachately v Británii, včetně náramků a satelitního sledování, zajišťují společnosti jako G4S a Serco. G4S sleduje přibližně 14 000 pachatelů pomocí GPS a mobilních technologií. Pachatelé nosí kotníkový náramek propojený se sledovacím zařízením a v jejich bydlišti bývá instalována domácí jednotka. Tento systém umožňuje úřadům sledovat pohyb osob jak v bytě, tak mimo něj. Elektronické náramky umožňují policii porovnávat pohyb pachatelů s hlášenými trestnými činy nebo zjistit, zda byl někdo při tísňovém volání na místě činu.

Martin 'Mad Dog' Allen returns with his latest MailOnline Sport column, where he shares candid thoughts on recent football issues. This week, the Barnet manager discusses Manchester United’s transfer moves, team spirit inspired by Gordon Strachan, and events at Barnet.

STRACHAN TEAM SPIRIT
Allen remembers Gordon Strachan’s take on team bonding, mixing humor about golf and Guinness with reflections on unity built through collective hard work. Strachan believed that close-knit teams could support each other in tough situations, leading to rewarding and proud moments after hard-earned victories.

Those lessons came to mind after Barnet’s first Conference game away at Chester. Without overnight stays—a result of redirecting funds to player wages—the team endured a nearly seven-hour journey caused by accidents and traffic. The rushed arrival left little time to warm up, but the players came together to achieve a remarkable 5-0 win. Allen credits their resilience and spirit for overcoming adversity.

KEVIN CAN'T GET ENOUGH
Guest coach Kevin Blackwell brought additional enthusiasm and expertise to Barnet training sessions. Out of work since leaving Bury, Blackwell’s energy positively influenced the squad. Allen notes the challenge was getting him off the pitch, thanks to his passion for player development.

COOKY IS ON FIRE
Lee Cook, a former QPR star, requested to train with Barnet to regain fitness. Initially hesitant, Allen invited him after learning of his experience and warned there was no budget for a contract. Cook impressed with his attitude and skills, eventually earning a one-year deal and quickly becoming Barnet’s leading scorer, even netting a hat-trick.

ALLEN'S ANALYSIS...A MANAGER TO WATCH
Allen praises Neil Aspin of Halifax Town for smart recruitment—signing driven players from lower leagues instead of those dropping down. After Halifax’s significant win over Barnet, Allen commends Aspin’s leadership and team spirit. He suggests Leeds United should consider Aspin as their next manager.

ONE CHANGE I’D MAKE: ‘FERGIE TIME’
Allen suggests football adopt rugby’s independent timekeeper, removing controversy over added time. He proposes that an official in the stands manage the clock and signal full-time audibly, which would add transparency and excitement—even if sometimes inconvenient for the losing team!

THE BIG ISSUE: UNITED’S TRANSFER POLICY
Allen questions Manchester United's decision to spend £60 million on Angel di Maria, believing that investment should have gone to defenders like Mats Hummels and Sami Khedira. He argues the team needs strengthening at the back and doubts United can win major trophies this season under Louis van Gaal.

article_content: The 2014 U.S. midterm elections resulted in a historic victory for the Republican Party, giving the GOP its largest congressional majority since World War II. In addition to this overall win, election night featured several historic milestones for individual candidates. Tim Scott became the first African-American from the South elected to the U.S. Senate since Reconstruction, and also the first African-American to be elected to both the House of Representatives and the Senate. Before him, the last black Senator from the South was Blanche Kelso Bruce, who left office 133 years ago. Mia Love made history as the first black Republican woman elected to Congress and the first Haitian-American to serve in Congress. Joni Ernst became the first woman from Iowa elected to either chamber of Congress and the first female combat veteran elected to the Senate. Shelley Moore Capito secured victory as the first woman elected to the Senate from West Virginia. Tom Cotton, a veteran of both the Iraq and Afghanistan wars, became the first veteran of these conflicts elected to the Senate. However, he is not the first Iraq War veteran to serve, as Sen. John Walsh, who led a combat battalion in Iraq, had previously been appointed to Montana's Senate seat, although he withdrew from his campaign following a plagiarism scandal. The North Carolina Senate race set a new spending record, with outside groups pouring in over $81 million in addition to the more than $32 million spent by candidates, according to the Center for Responsive Politics. For the first time in U.S. history, the number of women in Congress reached 100. Gina Raimondo made history as Rhode Island's first female governor, following support from President Barack Obama, First Lady Michelle Obama, and former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton. At age 30, Elise Stefanik became the youngest woman ever elected to Congress, representing New York’s 21st Congressional District.

Kromě celkového úspěchu přinesla volební noc také několik historických milníků jednotlivých kandidátů. Tim Scott se stal prvním Afroameričanem z Jihu, který byl zvolen do Senátu USA od období rekonstrukce, a zároveň prvním Afroameričanem, který byl zvolen jak do Sněmovny reprezentantů, tak do Senátu. Před ním byl posledním černošským senátorem z Jihu Blanche Kelso Bruce, který úřad opustil před 133 lety. Mia Love se zapsala do historie jako první černošská republikánská žena zvolená do Kongresu a první Haiťanka-Američanka, která v Kongresu působila. Joni Ernst se stala první ženou z Iowy, která byla zvolena do kterékoli komory Kongresu, a první ženou – bojovou veteránkou – zvolenou do Senátu. Shelley Moore Capito se stala první ženou zvolenou do Senátu v Západní Virginii. Tom Cotton, veterán z války v Iráku i Afghánistánu, se stal prvním veteránem těchto konfliktů zvoleným do Senátu. Není však prvním veteránem z války v Iráku v Senátu — senátor John Walsh, který velel bojovému praporu v Iráku, už byl dříve jmenován do Senátu za Montanu, ale odstoupil z kampaně po plagiátorské aféře. Senátní kampaň v Severní Karolíně stanovila nový rekord v útratách – externí skupiny do ní investovaly přes 81 milionů dolarů, kromě více než 32 milionů dolarů od kandidátů, podle Centra pro responzivní politiku. Ve věku 30 let se Elise Stefanik stala nejmladší ženou zvolenou do Kongresu jako zástupkyně 21. kongresového obvodu státu New York.

article_content: Edward Alexander Somerset, aged 54, son of the Duke of Beaufort and a member of one of Britain’s most prominent aristocratic families, is set to appear in court this week to face six charges of assault against his wife, Caroline Somerset. A preliminary hearing at Bristol Crown Court scheduled for Thursday will determine whether Lord Somerset will stand trial. He is accused of assaulting Lady Somerset, his wife of 30 years, on six separate occasions. Court documents state that the first alleged assault occurred at a London address more than 25 years ago, with the remaining alleged incidents taking place at Essex House on the Badminton Estate in Gloucestershire. The most recent incident reportedly happened last October. One of the more recent alleged assaults resulted in Lady Somerset’s hospitalization, which led to police involvement. Lord Somerset, who was educated at Millfield, has two adult daughters, Francesca and Rose, with Lady Somerset. Should the case proceed to trial, witnesses from both the aristocracy and the household staff at Badminton are expected to testify. The Somersets reside on the 52,000-acre Badminton Estate, which is known for hosting the world-famous Badminton Horse Trials. This year’s event will begin on Thursday, the same day as Lord Somerset’s court appearance. Lord Somerset’s father, David Somerset, the 11th Duke of Beaufort, is estimated to be worth £135 million. His elder brother, Henry John Fitzroy, Marquess of Worcester, is heir to the title and estate. The Somerset family possesses a notable lineage, with ties to Lord Bath of Longleat Estate and a dukedom established by Charles II in 1682. Beaufort is named after a castle in France, making it unique among current British dukedoms. The current duke is also chair of Marlborough Fine Art and was previously involved in a controversy regarding a council payment of £280,000 for the construction of a bridge over his land in Swansea. No public comments on the case are permitted for legal reasons.

article_content: New Zealand delivered one of the most dominant performances seen in one-day international cricket, thoroughly defeating England. While there were expectations that England would improve after playing Australia, their display against New Zealand was even more disappointing. Credit goes to New Zealand for putting on a complete display, led by Brendon McCullum's innovative and aggressive leadership. McCullum's imaginative attacking tactics and field placements provided a clear lesson in the modern approach to limited-overs cricket. After the heavy loss, England captain Eoin Morgan described McCullum as 'the most destructive batsman in the world.' England, however, continue to rely on traditional strategies, often selecting Test players like Gary Ballance over more aggressive options. If they persist with this conservative mindset, further defeats could be likely. There appeared to be a sense of fear within the team, in contrast to New Zealand's fearless approach. The chief cause of England's collapse was swing bowling, something they have encountered since their youth. Tim Southee's exceptional bowling earned him figures of 7-33, restricting England to just 123 runs. Despite the conditions being straightforward and not favoring spin, England struggled to adapt and perform. In response, McCullum, in fine form, chased down the target aggressively and did not allow the English bowlers to settle. Most of England's batsmen seemed out of form. Questions remain about late changes to the England squad before the Australia match and whether these decisions hindered their performance. England's policy of not giving extended opportunities to players like Alex Hales, who impressed in World Twenty20, has hurt their development. Instead of nurturing such talents, players are often dropped before they can gain confidence. England's approach to one-day cricket lacks the backing that players receive in Test matches. Overall, there is a significant gap between what Australia and New Zealand are achieving in limited-overs cricket and England's current standard. To close this gap before the World Cup, England must encourage players like Hales and Ben Stokes to play with the same freedom they show in domestic competitions. The focus should shift from rigid strategies to fostering a strong, positive team culture. Eoin Morgan may benefit from adopting a similar style to that of his counterpart, McCullum.

Po těžké porážce popsal anglický kapitán Eoin Morgan McCulluma jako „nejničivějšího pálkaře na světě“. Anglie však stále spoléhá na tradiční strategie a často vybírá hráče pro testovací zápasy, jako je Gary Ballance, místo agresivnějších možností. Pokud budou v této konzervativní strategii pokračovat, čekají je další prohry. V týmu se zdála být atmosféra strachu, na rozdíl od beze strachu hrajícího Nového Zélandu. Hlavní příčinou kolapsu Anglie bylo swingové házení, se kterým se setkávali už od mládí. Tim Southee svým vynikajícím výkonem získal 7 wicketů za 33 bodů a omezil Anglii na pouhých 123 bodů. article_content: A recently discovered bug in Google's latest mobile operating system, Android 4.2, omits the month of December from the People app. This application enables users to record friends' birthdays and important dates, but some are finding they cannot add December events—the calendar skips directly from November to January. Notably, the bug does not affect the system’s Calendar app; only the People app is affected. The flaw garnered swift and humorous reactions online, with tech news sites such as CNET jokingly asking if Google had become "the new Grinch who stole Christmas," and others noting that Android seems to believe there are only 11 months in a year. Google responded to the issue on its Android Google+ page, explaining that the bug only impacts optional fields in the People app, not the main Calendar, and promised to resolve it quickly. The devices impacted include the Galaxy Nexus phone and the Nexus 7 tablet, both running Android 4.2 (nicknamed Jelly Bean). December is still fully functional in the main Calendar app, so essential scheduling remains unaffected.

Chyba okamžitě vyvolala vlnu vtipných reakcí na internetu – technologické weby jako CNET žertovně naznačily, že se Google stal „novým Grinchem, který ukradl Vánoce“, a další dodali, že Android má očividně jen 11 měsíců. Google na problém reagoval na své stránce Androidu na Google+, kde vysvětlil, že chyba postihuje pouze volitelná pole v aplikaci Lidé a hlavní aplikace Kalendář zůstává nedotčena. Oprava má přijít brzy. Dotčená zařízení zahrnují telefon Galaxy Nexus a tablet Nexus 7 s operačním systémem Android 4.2 (přezdívaným Jelly Bean). Prosinec v hlavní aplikaci Kalendář funguje bez problémů, takže důležité plánování není ohroženo.
